pyqgis_plugin.about: This manager allows you to switch between views, add new ones, delete them, and organize them.

pyqgis_plugin.name: HERE QGIS Plugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: The HERE QGIS Plugin is a modular, Python-based integration that connects QGIS with HERE MapMaking and platform services.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The HERE QGIS Plugin is a modular, Python-based integration that connects QGIS with HERE MapMaking and platform services. It enables users to seamlessly visualize, explore, analyze, and edit geospatial data directly within QGIS, bridging HERE's proprietary ecosystem with a widely used open-source GIS environment.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Vectorel Digitizer Pro
pyqgis_plugin.description: Vectorel Digitizer Pro is a QGIS4 plugin for creating and editing vector features by entering, pasting or modifying numerical vertex coordinates. Includes a map-based polygon drawing tool with live area calculation. Also simultaneously converts coordinates according to CRS selection. Please do not hesitate to contact to report errors, problems, or suggestions. Thank you for your feedback and votes.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Vectorel Digitizer Pro adds three tools to the QGIS4 vector editing toolbar. 1. Add By Coordinates: create new features by typing vertex coordinates with real-time area calculation. 2. Coordinate Editor: edit existing features numerically, with copy/paste and reprojection support and real-time area display. 3. Drawing Digitizer: draw polygons directly on the map canvas with an editable coordinate table and real-time area display. Supports Point, Line, Polygon, Multi-part and Z/M geometries. Coordinate reprojection on the fly.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ArcGIS REST Attachments Viewer
pyqgis_plugin.description: View ArcGIS REST FeatureServer attachments directly from QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin detects ArcGIS REST FeatureServer layers, reads one or multiple selected features, queries their attachments by OBJECTID, and opens an HTML gallery with photos and files. Public services work directly. Private services may require a valid ArcGIS session or token.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ConnSyncer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Shows all DB datasources active in the current QGIS project and lets you register them in DB Manager with a single click. Supports GeoPackage, SpatiaLite and PostgreSQL.
pyqgis_plugin.about: When you load a layer from a GeoPackage, SpatiaLite or PostgreSQL database, QGIS uses it as a layer source but does not automatically add it to the DB Manager connections. This plugin scans the current project, lists every DB datasource it finds and lets you register them in DB Manager with a single click, choosing the connection name. No more manual reconfiguration of each connection.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Feature Navigation Dock
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin allows the user to navigate through features within a selected vector layer.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Feature Navigation Dock is a plugin for navigating through features in vector layers using manual controls, autoplay, selected-feature mode, and optional slider-based tools.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QRES - ResilienceMapper
pyqgis_plugin.description: Calculates and maps urban resilience values based on isochrone accessibility.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QRES is a QGIS plugin designed to assess the resilience of urban areas by analysing the spatial accessibility of essential features such as schools, parks, hospitals, and public transport. Unlike traditional distance based methods, QRES uses isochrones, areas reachable within equal travel times, to calculate resilience values that better reflect real world conditions. The workflow includes generating isochrones using Mapbox, computing resilience values for each sampled point, and producing attribute table outputs for GIS analysis and CSV export. The method was first introduced by Pintacuda L, Carta S, Turchi T, and Sabiu M in 2023 at the Responsive Cities Symposium at IAAC Barcelona. Processing large datasets may take time and a progress bar is displayed during execution. If processing is interrupted, previously calculated points retain their values and missing points can be recalculated separately. A Mapbox access token is required to generate isochrones and Mapbox provides a free usage tier suitable for most urban scale analyses. Info: https://www.herts.ac.uk/research/groups-and-units/arch/qres-resilience-mapper-for-qgis
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: MKS DTECH, Luigi Pintacuda, Silvio Carta, Tommaso Turchi

pyqgis_plugin.name: POICloud
pyqgis_plugin.description: Import jobs, fields, POIs and POI types from POICloud (poicloud.de) into QGIS as GeoPackage layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: POICloud (poicloud.de) is a web platform for agricultural drone operators and their customers. This plugin connects QGIS to a POICloud account through the POICloud API and brings operational data directly onto the map. Sign in with a POICloud account, then search and filter jobs by team and date range; the selected jobs are imported as QGIS layers (field polygons, POIs, jobs and the POI type catalogue) and stored in a local GeoPackage so they stay available offline. Each POI shows its POI/damage type along with the person who created it and the person who confirmed the type. Data can be refreshed manually and, optionally, synchronised automatically when a project is opened. The plugin is read-only and works with QGIS 3.22 and later, including QGIS 4 (Qt6). A POICloud account is required.

pyqgis_plugin.name: CO2GIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: CO2 transport pipeline routing and CAPEX estimation for CCS infrastructure planning.
pyqgis_plugin.about: CO2GIS is an open-source QGIS plugin for planning CO2 transport pipeline infrastructure. It integrates raster-based least-cost path (LCP) routing with cell-level capital-cost (CAPEX) estimation, enabling optimal pipeline corridor selection under multi-criteria land constraints. The plugin implements the COMET cost surface framework, hydraulic pipeline sizing via the Darcy-Weisbach equation, and automatic booster station placement on long segments. Two estimation modes — precise cell-by-cell and fast point-sampling — let users tune the accuracy/speed trade-off. Requires the GRASS GIS provider bundled with QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Quail
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin designed to get biodiversity data from a number of Living Atlases into QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.about: A plugin designed to get biodiversity data from a number of Living Atlases into QGIS. These include GBIF, the Atlas of Living Australia, Austria, Brazil, Flanders, Kew Gardens, Spain, Sweden, and the United Kingdom.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Amanda Buyan, Atlas of Living Australia

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoQA
pyqgis_plugin.description: Audit your vector layers for geometry, CRS, and attribute quality issues before spatial analysis.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoQA is an open-source QGIS plugin that automatically audits vector layers for geometry validity, coordinate reference system (CRS) configuration, and attribute data quality. It runs a modular, rule-based validation engine across your selected layers and generates a professional HTML and CSV audit report -- complete with an executive decision, per-layer scoring, severity classification, and actionable recommendations. Designed for GIS analysts, researchers, engineers, and students who need confidence in their data before running analysis.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QgisTreeBenefits
pyqgis_plugin.description: [IT] Stima dei benefici ambientali degli alberi (metodo Orebla) a partire da un dataset di punti-albero. Interfaccia bilingue italiano/inglese. Replica in QGIS i calcoli della piattaforma ARBOREO di ALIAS ATP: valore ecologico (CO2 stoccata/sequestrata, O2, inquinanti), valore ornamentale, runoff annuo ed evento, raffrescamento estivo, CO2 avanzata e simulazioni di mobilita. [EN] Environmental benefits of urban trees (Orebla method) from a tree-point dataset. Bilingual Italian/English interface, usable outside Italy through a generic average reference value.
pyqgis_plugin.about: [IT] Plugin per la stima dei benefici ambientali degli alberi urbani. Il valore ornamentale ed ecologico segue il metodo Orebla (autore: Luigi Sani). La stima di raffrescamento estivo e runoff evitato e i modelli di simulazione ambientale sono elaborati da ALIAS ATP (aliasinfo.it). Strumento a scopo dimostrativo e didattico: i risultati non costituiscono perizia o valutazione tecnica ufficiale. Dataset di 261 specie e 107 province italiane, piu una voce generica "Media Italia" per l'uso extra-Italia. Interfaccia in italiano e inglese: cambiano solo le etichette, i nomi dei campi e i valori memorizzati restano identici nelle due lingue. [EN] Plugin for assessing the environmental benefits of urban trees. Amenity and ecological value follow the Orebla method (author: Luigi Sani); summer cooling, avoided runoff and the environmental simulation models are developed by ALIAS ATP (aliasinfo.it). Demonstration and teaching tool: results are not an official appraisal. 261 species and 107 Italian provinces, plus a generic "Italy average" entry for use outside Italy. Italian and English interface: only labels change, field names and stored values are identical in both languages.

pyqgis_plugin.name: DB Manager (community)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Manage your databases within QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Manage your databases within QGIS. This is a copy of the legacy DB manager plugin which used to be installed by default. It is currently unmaintained.

pyqgis_plugin.name: NW OW Locator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Suche für Örtlichkeiten und Geodaten in den Kantonen Nidwalden und Obwalden | Search for places and data in the cantons Nidwalden and Obwalden
pyqgis_plugin.about: Locator-Integration für die Suche in der Geodateninfrastruktur der Kantone Obwalden und Nidwalden. Über dieses Plugin können Layer (WMS), Flurnamen, Adressen und andere Objekte in NW und OW gesucht und lokalisiert werden. | Locator integration for searching the geodata infrastructure of the cantons Obwalden and Nidwalden. This plugin can be used to search for and locate layers (WMS), field names, addresses, and other objects in NW and OW.

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02-Multimap: Sync-up Multimaps
pyqgis_plugin.description: Smart multi-panel layer comparison with synchronized canvases, extent bounding boxes, multi-panel feature inspector, live extent KPIs, legend drawer, scale presets, and offline HTML dashboards.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
02Multimap is an advanced, high-performance workspace plugin designed for comparative spatial analysis and multi-scenario map visualization. Ideal for urban planners, environmental researchers, and demographers, it allows you to compare multiple spatial patterns side-by-side in a coordinated layout. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://geophilo.com/zero2multimap/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitLab (https://gitlab.com/geophilo1/zero2multimap)!
Key Capabilities: 1. Synchronized Viewport Grids: Rebuild your workspace into 2, 3, 4, 6, or 8 synchronized map canvases (in horizontal, vertical, or grid matrices). 2. Dynamic Extent Bounding Box: Overlay the active viewport rectangle over all other viewports to visualize geographic context immediately. 3. Multi-Panel Feature Inspector: Query vector attributes and raster cell values at any coordinate point across all active viewports simultaneously. 4. Visual Spatial Difference Engine: Compute geometric differences between comparison layers with green (added) and red (removed) overlays. 5. Viewport Spatial KPIs & Area Chips: Calculate real-time bounding box polygon areas (ha/km²) and feature counts beneath each panel card. 6. Workspace Presets & Templates: Save and restore custom comparison layouts or use built-in scenario templates (Before & After, 4-Scenario Matrix, Temporal Timeline). 7. Unified Legend Drawer & Canvas HUD: Access a right-side drawer stacking all panel legends and overlay North arrow / scale graphics on canvas corners. 8. Synchronized Measurement Tool: Measure distance and area interactively across viewports in QGIS and exported HTML dashboards. 9. Professional Print Layouts & Multi-Theme HTML Dashboards: Export exact panel rendering to self-contained HTML files featuring Slate Light, Dark Midnight, and Emerald Clean themes with live theme switching, presentation slide mode, opacity controls, measurement tool, and legends.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ProfileMaster
pyqgis_plugin.description: Longitudinal profiles, cross-sections, 3D axis, DTM buffer and contour lines from vector alignments or loaded QGIS layers over Digital Terrain Models. / Perfiles longitudinales, transversales, eje 3D, buffer MDT y curvas de nivel desde archivos o capas cargadas en QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
QGIS plugin to generate topographic longitudinal profiles from vector alignments and Digital Terrain Models (GeoTIFF, ASC, IMG, BIL, FLT, DEM, HGT — any GDAL-supported format).
Supported alignment formats: DXF, SHP, KML, KMZ, GeoPackage, GML, GPX, GeoJSON. Automatic CRS reprojection (e.g. WGS84 axis over UTM DTM).
Main features: - DTM and alignment can be loaded from file/folder OR selected directly from layers already loaded in the QGIS project. - Smart DTM cache: scans folder once, reuses the index for subsequent runs. - Automatic detection of DTM tiles intersecting the alignment. - Bilinear interpolation of terrain elevations along the axis. - Configurable segmentation interval (e.g. 1 m for smooth profiles). - Longitudinal profile in standard topographic style: terrain line, comparison plane, partial/total distances in PK format (0+860) and elevations at original vertices. - Independent horizontal and vertical scales. - Automatic or fixed comparison plane. - DXF export with polylines, annotations and data table (guitar). - CSV export with partial/total distances and elevations. - Cross-section profiles: configurable spacing, width and scale. DXF grid layout with terrain, axis, PK, comparison plane and elevation table. - 3D axis export: original vertices with PK labels (horizontal text, no Z annotation) plus optional clean 3D polyline draped on DTM at segmentation interval. - DTM buffer export: GeoTIFF clipped to alignment bounding box + buffer, LZW-compressed. - Contour lines: DXF with normal and master contours, Chaikin smoothing, optional Douglas-Peucker vertex simplification (configurable tolerance) to keep straight stretches lightweight, and minimum-length filter to suppress tiny closed contours.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: longitudinal profile,trazado,road profile,perfil longitudinal,shp,profile,mdt,curvas de nivel,kml,contour lines,cross section,geotiff,transversal,3d axis,dxf,topography,alignment,contour,dem,terrain,dtm

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoStereonet
pyqgis_plugin.description: Industry-grade interactive stereonet plotter for structural geology. Plots planes and lines on Schmidt/Wulff nets with Kamb density contouring, eigenvector analysis, Fisher statistics, rose diagrams, fold axis detection, dip-direction conversion, and PNG/SVG/PDF export.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
GeoStereonet is a professional structural geology analysis plugin for QGIS.
PROJECTIONS ───────────────────────────────────────── • Equal-Area (Schmidt) lower hemisphere • Equal-Angle (Wulff) lower hemisphere
PLOT TYPES ───────────────────────────────────────── • Planes as great circles + poles • Linear elements (trend/plunge) as points • Kamb density contours — exponential / linear / raw kernels (Vollmer 1995), filled or line, sigma-adjustable • Eigenvector overlay (S1 / S2 / S3 principal axes) • Fisher mean vector + alpha-95 confidence cone • Auto-detected orientation "sets" via spherical k-means (Dips-style set-window analysis) • Rose diagram with automatic dominant-direction interpretation
STRUCTURAL ANALYSIS ───────────────────────────────────────── • Eigenvalue tensor (S1, S2, S3 + Woodcock K and C) • Fisher statistics (kappa, R-bar, alpha95, mean vector) • Best-fit girdle / fold axis (pi-diagram) • Mean plane determination • Two-plane intersection (beta-axis) • Angular distance between any two linear features • Dip-direction/dip to RHR strike/dip auto-conversion
DATA SOURCES ───────────────────────────────────────── • QGIS vector layers with live selection sync • CSV / TSV files with auto-delimiter detection
EXPORT ───────────────────────────────────────── • PNG (300 dpi), SVG (vector), PDF via Matplotlib

pyqgis_plugin.name: CartoDXF
pyqgis_plugin.description: Export QGIS vector layers to a professional DXF, one DXF layer per category, with real colors, line widths and line types. / Exporta capas vectoriales de QGIS a un DXF profesional, una capa DXF por categoría, con colores, grosores y tipos de línea reales.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
QGIS plugin to export loaded vector layers (points, lines, polygons) to a single professional DXF file, ready to open in AutoCAD or any CAD software.
Main features: - One DXF layer per category: choose a field per QGIS layer to split it into several DXF layers automatically (e.g. one DXF layer per road type, per land use...). - Independent label/text field: write any field value as DXF text next to each feature, regardless of the field used for the DXF layer name. - Exact colors (true color RGB) read from the QGIS symbology, plus an automatic ACI fallback for older DXF viewers that don't support true color. - Real line widths and line types (dashed, dotted, dash-dot...) taken from the QGIS simple line symbology. - Polygons exported with fill (hatch) and independent outline: solid fill or a selectable pattern (diagonal lines, horizontal lines, grid, dots) with adjustable scale; optional setting to make the outline match the fill color, useful with "Categorized" renderers where only the fill color varies. - Points exported as DXF POINT entities, with an option to also insert a DXF block (INSERT) approximating the QGIS marker shape (circle, square, triangle, diamond, cross, X, star, pentagon, hexagon...). - Optional export limited to the current canvas view, with geometries clipped to that extent instead of exported whole. - Text labels try to preserve their QGIS orientation (data-defined rotation, or the line's own direction for road-name style labels) instead of always being exported horizontal. - Automatic reprojection to the QGIS project CRS. - A faulty feature (invalid geometry, unusual category value...) is skipped instead of aborting the whole export.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GisBR
pyqgis_plugin.description: Load official Brazilian spatial data (IBGE/IPEA geobr + censobr) and run a municipal Master Plan diagnostic in QGIS, using only the native QGIS API.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GISBR brings the "one line -> one layer" access of the geobr/censobr packages (IPEA) into QGIS as a Processing provider, using only the native QGIS/Qt API and the Python standard library (no geopandas/requests/pandas). Phase 1: legacy GeoPackage backend (geobr v1.7.0), fully native. Phase 2: Parquet backend (geobr v2.0.0) read via the GDAL Parquet driver or a pyarrow fallback, plus a join with census tables from censobr. On top of the geobr mirror, GISBR adds a municipal Master Plan diagnostic: a dock panel (state -> municipality) that loads official layers organized in 8 axes (transport, sanitation, demography, environment, education, health, urban, administrative) from WFS and ArcGIS REST services, clipped to the municipality polygon and saved to a local GeoPackage, with an optional Esri World Imagery satellite basemap. Data in SIRGAS 2000 / EPSG:4674. Licensed under GPL-3.0.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Universal Map2web
pyqgis_plugin.description: Export QGIS layers to interactive web maps with Leaflet
pyqgis_plugin.about: Export vector layers from QGIS to interactive HTML maps with Leaflet, preserving QGIS symbology and styles. Multi-language support (English/French). Optional dynamic PostgreSQL/PostGIS mode: layers stay connected live to the database via a secure PHP endpoint instead of a static GeoJSON dump.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Q-Data-Pen
pyqgis_plugin.description: Quick and easy edit polygon attributes with a single mouse click.| Schnelles Bearbeiten von Polygon-Attributen per Mausklick.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Q-Data-Pen is a lightweight and intuitive tool designed to speed up your digitizing and editing workflow. Instead of navigating through the standard attribute table or bulky forms, simply activate the tool, click on a polygon, and instantly update its attribute values in a compact, user-friendly popup dialog. Developed with AI assistance (Google Gemini) for code optimization and logic structure. --- Q-Data-Pen ist ein einfaches und intuitives Werkzeug, das Ihren Digitalisierungs- und Bearbeitungsablauf beschleunigt. Anstatt sich durch die Standard-Attributtabelle oder umfangreiche Formulare zu navigieren, aktivieren Sie einfach das Werkzeug, klicken auf ein Polygon und aktualisieren dessen Attributwerte sofort in einem kompakten, benutzerfreundlichen Popup-Dialog. Erstellt mit Unterstützung von KI (Google Gemini) zur Code-Optimierung und Logik-Strukturierung.

pyqgis_plugin.name: MatchFeature
pyqgis_plugin.description: Copy attributes and visual style from one feature to others in the same layer, in two steps (inspired by AutoCAD's MATCHPROP).
pyqgis_plugin.about: MatchFeature brings the "match properties" idea to QGIS. It works in two simple steps inside a single editable vector layer: (1) select ONE source feature and click the button to COPY its attributes; (2) select one or more target features and click again to APPLY those values to them. It copies every editable field while skipping identifier/auto-increment columns (fid, id, id1, gid, objectid, *_id, ...) and read-only fields, and for Categorized/Graduated styles it copies the classification attribute so targets inherit the source symbol. Incompatible fields are skipped silently, the source feature is never modified, and the whole apply step is a single Undo (Ctrl+Z). Works with point, line and polygon layers. Idea & design by Hugo P. Teixeira; built with Emergent. Inspired by AutoCAD's MATCHPROP command. License: GPL v2 or later.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GPBoost Spatial Predictor
pyqgis_plugin.description: Spatial prediction with GPBoost, combining tree boosting and Gaussian processes for point observations.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GPBoost Spatial Predictor trains GPBoost models for spatial prediction from point layers with numeric response and covariate fields. It combines tree boosting for nonlinear covariate-response relationships with a Gaussian Process component for spatial residual autocorrelation. External dependency: the Python package gpboost>=1.4.0 must be available in the same Python environment used by QGIS. Version 1.0.6 adds both author LinkedIn profiles to the Info tab and documentation, keeps the non-blocking Info tab, and maintains the guided in-plugin installer/update button for gpboost, avoiding manual console use when the platform allows pip installation. The plugin includes an interactive dialog, a QGIS Processing algorithm, model comparison/tuning tools, and English, Spanish, and Portuguese interface labels. Current limitation: when creating prediction rasters from selected covariate fields, covariates are fixed at their median values over the prediction grid; future versions should accept raster covariate layers for fully covariate-varying maps.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoCenso2024
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS plugin to access, download and link geospatial information from the 2024 Census of Bolivia.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoCenso2024 permite acceder a mapas, bases de datos y capas geoespaciales relacionadas con el Censo Nacional de Población y Vivienda 2024 de Bolivia. El complemento permite descargar información desde repositorios externos, organizar archivos en caché local y vincular datos censales con capas cargadas en QGIS. Este complemento no es oficial; la información debe validarse con las plataformas oficiales del INE para uso técnico, académico o institucional.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Ing. MSc. Jorge Ayala Niño de Guzmán

pyqgis_plugin.name: Ochave Curvo
pyqgis_plugin.description: Creates a 5-meter curved chamfer directly in QGIS for urban cadastre, cadastral mapping, and georeferenced lot design.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Ochave Curvo was created as a practical response to a common need in urban cartographic work: the lack of a direct tool for generating curved chamfers inside QGIS. Designed for users working in urban cadastre, cadastral mapping, land parcel design, and georeferenced urban plans, this plugin automatically creates a curved chamfer with a fixed radius of 5 meters, reducing manual calculations, geometric adjustments, and dependence on external tools. Its purpose is to provide a simple, precise, and accessible solution for those who build urban information through cartography, strengthening QGIS as a free and open-source tool for municipal, cadastral, and urban technical workflows.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Ing. MSc. Jorge Ayala Niño de Guzmán
pyqgis_plugin.tags: urban planning,georeferenced lots,vector editing,urban cadastre,curved chamfer,cadastral mapping,cadastre

pyqgis_plugin.name: Geosoft GRD Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Load Oasis Montaj (Geosoft) binary .grd grid files into QGIS as raster layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A simple plugin to load Geosoft/Oasis Montaj binary .grd grid files directly into QGIS. Select a .grd file (or a whole folder/list of them for batch conversion, with drag-and-drop support), optionally set a coordinate reference system (remembered between sessions), and the grid(s) are converted to GeoTIFF and added as raster layers, optionally grouped by source folder.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Online Map Clipper
pyqgis_plugin.description: Clip online basemaps using a vector mask at chosen zoom level.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Renders only the selected online map layer at a specified tile zoom level, then clips it with a polygon vector layer. Output is a GeoTIFF with transparent background.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoData Forge
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate repeatable synthetic geospatial datasets for testing, demos, QA, and privacy-safe sharing.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Generate repeatable synthetic geospatial datasets for testing, demos, QA, and privacy-safe sharing. Add templates for cadastral, utilities, telecom, and forestry with realistic data attributes.

pyqgis_plugin.name: FAO Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Downloads WaPOR and other FAO raster data for a region of interest.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin gives access to raster data published by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations through the FAO GISMGR 2.0 API (data.apps.fao.org), including the WaPOR water productivity datasets and many other FAO workspaces (CHIRPS, ASIS, GAEZ, GLW and more). Users define their study region in their QGIS project and download spatial subsets of the selected datasets while the program runs in the background. Filtering, and minor statistical options are available as well.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TLGeo2QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: It is a qgis agent, and a client for access tlgeo data source.
pyqgis_plugin.about: It is a QGIS agent and a client to access TLGeo data sources, allowing users to collaborate, publish, and manage layers seamlessly with TLGeo platform.

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02CadGis Universal CAD/GIS Importer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Convert AutoCAD DWG/DXF, Netcad NCZ/NCA drawings, KML/KMZ, GML, GeoJSON, CSV, SpatiaLite, GPX, DGN, and GDB datasets directly into optimized GeoPackage layers with QGIS styling.
pyqgis_plugin.about: An advanced CAD and GIS dataset converter utility for the PlanX ecosystem, with native & ODA-assisted support for AutoCAD DWG (*.dwg) and DXF drawings, Netcad NCZ/NCA, KML, KMZ, GML, GeoJSON, delimited CSV/TSV text with automatic X/Y or WKT geometry detection, SpatiaLite/SQLite, GPX, DGN, and GDB formats directly, with drag-and-drop loading, pre-conversion layer preview and selection, CAD collinear simplification, coordinate transformation, automatic labeling, database joins, and remembered import and export folders across sessions. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://geophilo.com/zero2cadgis/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitLab (https://gitlab.com/geophilo1/zero2cadgis)!

pyqgis_plugin.name: MAJ_version_Qgis
pyqgis_plugin.description: Modify the QGIS version recorded in the current .qgz project file. If the project to be modified is a QGIS 4 project, apply fixes for QGIS 3.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds an icon to the QGIS toolbar. The tool provides a dropdown list of QGIS versions, modifies the version attribute of the .qgs file contained within the .qgz archive, creates a backup, reloads the project, closes the version warning banner (if present), and replaces targeted fonts only if a missing-font banner is detected upon opening or reloading the project.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ENCoreGIS | pro
pyqgis_plugin.description: Peau du Monde | dataBridge - load, portray, audit and validate S-57 / Inland ENC and S-101 charts, with an ECDIS-style Chart Viewer and S-100 overlays (S-102 / S-104 / S-111). NOT FOR NAVIGATION.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Peau du Monde | dataBridge, the viewer, auditor and validator of the Peau du Monde lineup. Reads S-57, Inland ENC and S-101 charts with its own ISO 8211 engine and portrays them in an ECDIS-style Chart Viewer with S-100 overlays (S-102 bathymetry, S-104 tides, S-111 currents). It also audits cells against IHO / Inland-ENC standards and cross-checks them against authoritative source data. Runs on QGIS 3.x and 4.x from one code base. IMPORTANT: the audit and validation features are EXPERIMENTAL - treat findings as indicative only, never a substitute for approved ENC validation software. NOT FOR NAVIGATION; use at your own risk and respect the dataset producers' ownership and IP. Companion to Peau du Monde. GPL-3.0-or-later (full attribution in the bundled LICENSE).

pyqgis_plugin.name: FraXtex
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automatic geological fracture mapping from an RGB orthophoto, with or without a DEM
pyqgis_plugin.about: FraXtex is a QGIS 3/4 plugin for automatic fracture mapping in two stages: (1) generate a fracture probability map from an RGB orthophoto, with or without a DEM, using ONNX deep learning models (3-channel RGB and 4-channel RGB+DEM models are both supported; the right one is read from the model's declared input shape, falling back to whether a DEM was supplied when the model exports that dimension symbolically), and (2) vectorize the probability map into LineString geometry. Dependencies (numpy, rasterio, scikit-image, onnxruntime, geopandas, shapely, pygeoops) are auto-installed on first run via pip. If auto-install fails, a platform-specific manual command is shown in the Processing log. See the README for manual install instructions for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

pyqgis_plugin.name: VectorBatchSaver
pyqgis_plugin.description: Saves multiple layers in different formats in a batch mode.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Saves multiple vector layers in multiple formats of your choice at once in a customizable folder destination. Originally by Riccardo Klinger (https://github.com/riccardoklinger/batch-vector-layer-saver).

pyqgis_plugin.name: AIS Watchkeeper
pyqgis_plugin.description: Live AIS vessel tracking in QGIS from serial, TCP or internet (aisstream.io) sources, with guard-zone alarms, route monitoring, coverage mapping and voyage history.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Turns QGIS into a live maritime traffic console: connects to an AIS receiver over USB/serial, a raw TCP stream or an internet feed, decodes !AIVDM/!AIVDO and plots vessels live. Guard-zone alarms, route monitoring, coverage mapping, vessel info and a history recorder; routes are drawn with the native QGIS tools and Europe's waterways come from a built-in WFS. Requires pyserial and pyais (bundled). Issues: contact-project+foss4maritime-aiswatchkeeper-84121396-issue-@incoming.gitlab.com

pyqgis_plugin.name: InfoSIPEB
pyqgis_plugin.description: Access to the official INFO-SIPEB Geoportal from QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Connects QGIS to the official INFO-SIPEB Geoportal, allowing users to browse and download thematic maps directly from the platform.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Ing. MSc. Jorge Ayala Niño de Guzmán (impulsado por QGISBolivia.org)

pyqgis_plugin.name: IOF Assistent
pyqgis_plugin.description: Assistant for creating the cartography of a Forest Management Instrument (IOF) according to the specifications of the Centre de la Propietat Forestal de Catalunya, and exporting its GIS data.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Aquest complement permet crear les 8 capes vectorials d'un IOF amb tots els camps necessaris per a la digitalització i elaboració de la cartografia de gestió, incorporar cartografia de suport (cadastral i de referència de l'ICGC: mapa base topogràfic, mapa referencial topogràfic territorial i ortofotomapa), i exportar el fitxer de text de dades SIG per a la importació a PDF de l'IOF segons les normes de redacció del CPF.
IOF Assistent utilitza els serveis web de la Direcció General del Cadastre (ATOM INSPIRE) i de l'ICGC (geoserveis WMS), i el complement oficial «Open ICGC» per a la descàrrega de cartografia vectorial de referència territorial.
IOF Assistent utilitza «defusedxml» per a l'anàlisi segura del feed XML del Cadastre; s'inclou vendoritzat a ext_libs/, no cal instal·lar-lo manualment.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Basemap Tile Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Download a WMS, WMTS, WCS, XYZ, or ArcGIS REST basemap over an extent and mosaic it into a GeoTIFF.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Auto-detects whether the chosen layer is a WMS, WMTS, WCS, XYZ, or ArcGIS REST MapServer source. Tiles the request over a chosen extent (WMS GetMap / WCS GetCoverage at a chosen resolution/CRS, or WMTS / Web-Mercator {z}/{x}/{y} at a chosen zoom), downloads with adaptive throttling and a resumable SQLite work queue, georeferences each tile, and builds a compressed, tiled GeoTIFF mosaic (with overviews) using GDAL. WCS coverages (e.g. elevation) are fetched losslessly and keep their native samples and nodata. Optionally reprojects to a chosen output CRS and crops to the exact extent. Requires the GDAL Python bindings. For personal and educational use only — respect each provider's Terms of Service and usage limits.

pyqgis_plugin.name: RoadDigitizz
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive road digitizing with automatic centerline and polygon creation using real-time buffer preview.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
RoadDigitizz: Smart Road Digitizing for QGIS
Draw a road centerline and let the plugin automatically create both the centerline and the corresponding road polygon with a real-time buffer preview. Perfect for transportation mapping, urban planning, and GIS data creation.
Features: • Real-time buffer preview • Configurable road width • Multiple cap & join styles • Snap support & undo • Optional road width attribute storage (RDZWidth) • Automatic CRS-aware distance handling
Digitize once, get both layers instantly.

pyqgis_plugin.name: 360ForYou Uploader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Upload raster, vector and point cloud layers from QGIS to a 360-for-you.com project
pyqgis_plugin.about: Uploads data from the current QGIS project to 360-for-you.com or a self-hosted 360ForYou server and creates a viewer project you can share by link. Raster layers are uploaded as GeoTIFF (rendered RGBA export, or the source file when it is already an RGB GeoTIFF), vector layers are exported to KML, point cloud layers upload their LAS/LAZ source files, and arbitrary files can be added from disk. Uploads are chunked and resumable and run in the QGIS task manager. Requires an account and an API key (Profile - API keys, scopes projects:read and projects:write). The server URL is configurable for self-hosted installations. Uses only the QGIS/Python standard library - no external dependencies.

pyqgis_plugin.name: PANSA DroneMap Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Pobieranie i filtrowanie struktur przestrzeni powietrznej oraz stref geograficznych BSP bezpośrednio z serwerów PAŻP (DroneMap). / Downloading and filtering airspace structures and UAS geographical zones directly from PANSA (DroneMap) servers.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
[PL] Wtyczka pozawala na bezpośrednie pobieranie z oficjalnego interfejsu serwerowego PAŻP (api.dronemap.pansa.pl) pliku KML, obrazującego strefy przestrzeni powietrznej i strefy geograficzne BSP, konwersji w locie do zgrupowanych warstw tymczasowych wraz ze stylizacją. Pozwala na: 1. Pobieranie struktur z podziałem hierarchicznym i zaawansowanym grupowaniem.
2.Selektywne filtrowanie wysokości do zadanego progu w metrach AGL.
3. Ograniczanie zasięgu na podstawie warstwy buforowej/maski lotów.
4. Dynamiczne etykietowanie stref i definiowanie kontrastowych podświetleń.
Wtyczka do poprawnego działania wymaga zestawu standardowych bibliotek. W środowiskach Windows i OS X instalatory QGIS dostarczają je domyślnie. W niektórych dystrybucjach Linux konieczna może być ich manualna weryfikacja. Przed uruchomieniem wtyczki upewnij się, że w środowisku interpreterów Pythona QGIS zainstalowane są pakiety: requests i urllib3
[EN]
The plugin allows for direct download of KML files representing airspace structures and UAS geographical zones directly from the official PANSA server interface (api.dronemap.pansa.pl), with on-the-fly conversion into styled, grouped memory layers. It features: 1. Downloading structures with hierarchical division and advanced grouping.
2. Selective altitude filtering up to a specified threshold in meters AGL.
3. Restricting the extent based on a buffer layer or a flight mask.
4. Dynamic zone labeling and defining high-contrast highlights.
The plugin requires a set of standard libraries to function properly. In Windows and OS X environments, QGIS installers provide them by default. In some Linux distributions, manual verification may be necessary. Before running the plugin, make sure that the 'requests' and 'urllib3' packages are installed in the QGIS Python interpreter environment.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Marcin Kelm (KELM Solutions) supported by Gemini and Claude AI

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoAccuracy
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate confusion matrices and advanced mapping accuracy statistics (Overall, User, Producer, Balanced Accuracy, Cohen's Kappa, MCC, F1-Score, Quantity/Allocation Disagreements) comparing classified maps with ground truth rasters.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Generate confusion matrices and advanced mapping accuracy statistics (Overall, User, Producer, Balanced Accuracy, Cohen's Kappa, MCC, F1-Score, Quantity/Allocation Disagreements) comparing classified maps with ground truth rasters. Fully compliant with modern QGIS versions and optimized for large datasets.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: remote sensing,error matrix,f1-score,mcc,land cover validation,cohens kappa,confusion matrix,accuracy assessment,map comparison

pyqgis_plugin.name: DigDok
pyqgis_plugin.description: Basemaps and data layers for the Norwegian cultural-heritage sector
pyqgis_plugin.about:
DigDok Maps adds one-click menu shortcuts for background maps and Norwegian open-data / cultural-heritage layers, aimed at archaeology and heritage documentation.
Norwegian sources: Riksantikvaren (kulturminner), Kartverket (topographic cache, Matrikkelen, historical maps, administrative units, elevation), NGU (geology), NIBIO (land resources), Geodata, UNIMUS (Gjenstandsbasen) and ADED (excavation data).
Global basemaps: Google, Bing, Esri, Carto, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, F4map and Stadia Maps (incl. the Stamen styles, shaded relief, terrarium and vector tilesets). Stadia layers need a free API key, set from the DigDok menu and stored in the QGIS authentication database. All layers carry attribution.
Derived from the HCMGIS plugin by Thang Quach (opengeoshub/HCMGIS, GPL-3.0): https://github.com/opengeoshub/HCMGIS

pyqgis_plugin.name: IGN PluginsManager
pyqgis_plugin.description: PluginsManager allowing the installation, update and organization of IGN extensions in the IGN menu and/or toolbars according to a defined profile.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
PluginsManager is a dedicated manager for IGN plugins in QGIS. It allows users to: - Install IGN plugins from available repositories (qgis.org or GitHub) based on a given profile - Automatically detect available updates for installed IGN plugins and install new versions - Organize IGN plugins into IGN menu and customizable toolbars according to user needs
The goal of this plugin is to simplify the deployment, maintenance and daily use of IGN extensions within QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: IGN ShortestPath
pyqgis_plugin.description: Route selection based on the 'shortest path' algorithm, the "IGN PluginsManager" plugin must be installed beforehand.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Route selection based on the 'shortest path' algorithm

pyqgis_plugin.name: Spatial Bookmark Extents
pyqgis_plugin.description: Displays QGIS spatial bookmark extents as toggleable map-canvas rectangles with buffered, overlap-aware bookmark names, and exports extents to GeoPackage and other vector formats.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds a toolbar toggle that displays spatial bookmarks from the current project and the application bookmark store as transient canvas overlays. No temporary layers are added to the project. An export action saves bookmark extents as polygons to GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoJSON, or KML.

pyqgis_plugin.name: IGN DigitizingDirection
pyqgis_plugin.description: Displays the digitizing direction of features by drawing directional arrows, making it easier to verify geometry orientation during editing and quality control
pyqgis_plugin.about: Displays the digitizing direction of features by drawing directional arrows, making it easier to verify geometry orientation during editing and quality control The IGN Plugins Manager must be installed first.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Garmin Export
pyqgis_plugin.description: Professional Garmin IMG export for QGIS 3.22+ with Qt5/Qt6 dual support, modern localized UI, 12 languages and reliable mkgmap workflows
pyqgis_plugin.about: Professional Garmin Export tool with a Processing Toolbox provider for QGIS Modeler and batch workflows, converting QGIS vector layers to Garmin IMG format using the mkgmap compiler. Supports QGIS 3.44/Qt5 and QGIS 4.2/Qt6 through a shared compatibility boundary. The UI provides live/restart-safe translation, SVG language flags, RTL Arabic, readable combo/check controls, retranslate-safe dialogs, tooltips and actions. Features: one-click download of the full mkgmap/splitter distributions (zip archives with all dependency libraries; QGIS forbids bundling jars), automatic TYP styling generated from QGIS layer symbology, JSON-based type mapping, multi-level map support, advanced mkgmap tuning and logging options, comprehensive label code-page support (UTF-8 plus Windows/DOS/CJK pages), batch processing of all project layers, and a 12-language interface (EN, RU, DE, ES, FR, PT, ZH, HI, AR, ID, TH, VI). Requires Java (JRE 8+) which the plugin can auto-detect.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Batch KMZ Exporter
pyqgis_plugin.description: Export one or multiple selected layers (with symbology, labels, and attributes preserved exactly as shown on the map) into a single combined KMZ file.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Batch KMZ Exporter allows you to export multiple selected QGIS layers into a single KMZ file, with each layer organized as a separate folder in Google Earth. Placemark labels are exported only for layers with labeling enabled, preserving the configured field or expression, text color, and relative text size. All geometries are clamped to the ground by default: lines and polygons are tessellated to accurately follow terrain, while point markers are anchored at their true center. Data-defined point rotation is preserved using KML's native icon heading, ensuring correct per-feature orientation. The plugin reads QGIS symbology directly from single, categorized, and graduated renderers and recreates it in KML using the SimpleKML library. Additional features include automatic reprojection to WGS84, a progress dialog during export, and a one-click option to open the exported KMZ directly in Google Earth.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Map Extent From Layer
pyqgis_plugin.description:
A simple plugin that automatically links a layer's extent to layout map items, with an adjustable percentage buffer.
--You can easily and precisely set relevant extent to your maps based on any project layers--
----------
Usage:
1. Open a Print Layout and select (or add) a map item.
2. Click the Map Extent From Layer button in the layout toolbar to show the panel.
3. Tick Link extent to layer, choose a source layer.
4. The map extent now follows that layer. It re-evaluates on refresh/export, and (for vector layers) after each commit.
5. OPTIONAL: change buffer around the layer original extent. less then 100% for larger scale map or above 100% from smaller scale.
6. Untick to freeze and return to manual extent control, using other method if needed.
Keep in mind that the map extent may change as the layer source extent change while it toggled on.
The link is live, toggleable, and stored natively in the project Because the link is implemented with the map item's data-defined extent properties, it keeps working even for people who open the project without this plugin installed — the plugin is simply a convenient UI for setting and clearing those expressions.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A simple plugin that automatically links a layer's extent to layout map items, with an adjustable percentage buffer.
IT Adds a small dock to the Print Layout designer. Pick any vector or raster layer in your project and link the selected map item's extent to that layer's extent.
A buffer field lets you grow or shrink the linked extent by a percentage (100% = exact extent). When enabled the four extent bounds become data-defined expressions, so the link keeps working even without this plugin installed.
Toggle off keeps the map at its current view and returns it to manual control. For vector layers, the layout preview is refreshed automatically when you finish an edit session (commit).
Licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Dashboard
pyqgis_plugin.description: Build ArcGIS-Dashboards-style interactive dashboards from your QGIS project layers — indicators, charts, lists, a live map element, and cross-filtering selectors all wired together through a signal bus. By Isaac Enage (byZenterra).
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS Dashboard by Isaac Enage is an interactive dashboard builder for QGIS. Add data-driven elements (indicator, serial/bar chart, pie/donut chart, list) bound to vector layers via the QGIS expression engine, plus a live map element and a category selector that cross-filters every other element. Layout and configuration persist inside the .qgz project file. Developed and maintained by Isaac Enage of byZenterra. Guides, the dashboard gallery, and more QGIS plugins by Isaac Enage are at https://qgis.byzenterra.org/qdashboards

pyqgis_plugin.name: Basdonax Keyline from DEM
pyqgis_plugin.description: Computational design of Keyline infiltration lines from DEM/DTM.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Basdonax Keyline from DEM is a QGIS Processing plugin for computational design of infiltration lines, Keyline-inspired layouts and regenerative hydrological landscape planning from digital terrain models. It includes DEM validation, hydrological analysis, D8 flow accumulation, potential drainage detection, design units, intelligent mother lines and multicriteria optimization using WDI and ICL indicators.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Metadata Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create and manage QGIS layer metadata with smart defaults, layer browser, and guided wizard. Integrates with inventory databases for efficient metadata workflows.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Metadata Manager is a TRUE one-stop-shop for geospatial metadata management! Now includes BUILT-IN inventory creation - no need for separate Processing scripts. Create comprehensive geospatial data inventories directly within the plugin, then seamlessly create metadata for your layers. Features: (1) Integrated Inventory Scanner with full inventory_miner functionality, (2) Smart Defaults auto-populate from ALL metadata sources (FGDC, ESRI, ISO 19115, .qmd, embedded), (3) Layer Browser with filtering and Next/Previous navigation, (4) 4-step guided wizard with contact/link management, (5) Metadata Quality Dashboard with statistics and drill-downs, (6) Auto-save to database cache and .qmd files, (7) Unified GeoPackage database for inventory + metadata. Perfect for data managers who need to catalog AND document large geospatial data collections in a single, efficient workflow.

pyqgis_plugin.name: MapSplat
pyqgis_plugin.description: Export QGIS projects to static web maps using PMTiles and MapLibre GL JS
pyqgis_plugin.about:
MapSplat exports your QGIS project layers to self-contained web map packages that can be hosted on any static web server. It converts vector and raster layers to PMTiles format and generates a ready-to-deploy HTML viewer using MapLibre GL JS.
Features: - Export vector layers to PMTiles format - Export raster layers as basemap tiles - Automatic symbology conversion to MapLibre styles - Self-contained offline viewer (no CDN required) - Style roundtripping with Maputnik editor - Auto-reprojection to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857)

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoSpecies Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Herramientas GEE y preparación de datos para especies. / GEE tools and data preparation for species modeling.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Plugin para descarga de variables (WorldClim, SoilGrids, Variables Climáticas Actuales) con GEE y preparación de datos para MaxEnt. / QGIS Plugin providing Google Earth Engine tools for downloading environmental variables and utilities for species data preparation (MaxEnt).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Raster Scatter
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plots two raster datasets against each other and fits a linear regression.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Select two raster layers, sample them on a common grid, and render a scatter plot with a fitted linear regression and R2 value.

pyqgis_plugin.name: DDM Line Direction
pyqgis_plugin.description: Overlay and animate lines/polylines with per-field arrowhead styling.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds a live canvas overlay for line direction visualisation. Arrow density adapts with map scale: networks are sparse when zoomed out and more detailed when zoomed in. Direction follows vertex order, i.e. the original digitising direction of each line feature. Arrowheads can be styled based per field value: each styling rule matches a field value and sets its own fill, outline, opacity, size, density and animation speed, with a default style for the rest. Arrowheads can also be animated along the linework with customisable speed. Several line layers can be overlaid at once, each with its own styling rules and animation. Licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Profili, Sezioni e Comuni
pyqgis_plugin.description: IT: Profili altimetrici (con anteprima live ProfiloExpress), sezioni con volumi di sterro/riporto, download DTM, ricerca comuni via ISTAT e confronto prima/dopo. / EN: Elevation profiles (with a live ProfiloExpress preview), cross sections with cut/fill volumes, DTM download, ISTAT-based municipality search and before/after comparison.
pyqgis_plugin.about: IT: Strumento avanzato in grafica SPATIQON per profili altimetrici (con anteprima live ProfiloExpress durante il disegno) e con confronto affiancato dello stile "picchettato", sezioni trasversali reali con sterri/riporti/accumuli, disegni tecnici vettoriali, download raster da area SHIFT-draw dagli ZIP ufficiali TINITALY 1.1 e HR-DTM-5m Zenodo con progress/ETA e citazione/licenza, ricerca comuni e confini amministrativi ufficiali direttamente dall'archivio ISTAT (cache locale dopo il primo download, nessuna dipendenza da OpenStreetMap/Nominatim), confronto prima/dopo lavori tra GeoPackage generati dal plugin e tra DTM (raster differenza con volumi di scavo/riporto) con schede risultati separate per Profilo/Sezioni/Confronto, ed esportazioni PNG/PDF/CSV/GPKG/layout QGIS. --- EN: Advanced SPATIQON-style tool for elevation profiles (with a live "ProfiloExpress" preview while drawing) shown side by side with a classic "picchettata" comparison style, real cross sections with cut/fill/stockpile volumes, vector technical drawings, SHIFT-draw raster download from the official TINITALY 1.1 and HR-DTM-5m Zenodo archives with progress/ETA and citation/licence info, municipality search and official administrative boundaries fetched directly from the ISTAT archive (cached locally after the first download, no OpenStreetMap/Nominatim dependency), before/after works comparison between plugin-generated GeoPackages and between DTMs (difference raster with cut/fill volumes) with separate Profile/Sections/Comparison result tabs, and PNG/PDF/CSV/GPKG/QGIS layout exports.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Raster Loader +
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin for managing large raster datasets, loading and copying.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Wtyczka pozwala na wczytywanie i kopiowanie arkuszy map w postaci rastrów. POLISH: W przypadku danych czarno-białych zestaw należy tworzyć z zaznaczonym kolorem czarnym jako przezroczystym. Obsługuje rastry w trybie RGB: GeoTIFF/TIFF, JPEG, JPEG2000, PNG, BMP, IMG (ERDAS), ECW, MrSID, NITF, HDF, NetCDF, GRIB, ASCII Grid, DEM, VRT. Obsługuje pliki georeferencji: ("world files": geotiff, tfw, jgw, pgw, bpw, j2w, wld, prj, aux.xml) Funkcje: 1. Wczytywanie rastrów: kliknięcie lub kliknięcie + przytrzymanie i zaznaczenie obszaru (prostokąt). 2. Ustawianie przezroczystości: biały (255,255,255) domyślnie, opcjonalnie czarny (0,0,0). 3. Zestawy danych zapisywane w osobnych plikach .txt w folderze C:\\Users\\<użytkownik>\\Documents\\qzsit. 4. Kopiowanie wszystkich plików o tej samej nazwie bazowej, bez nadpisywania istniejących. 5. Informacja o ilości wczytanych, usuniętych, skopiowanych rastrów po 2 sekundach automatycznie znika i nie blokuje pracy. 6. Usuwanie rastrów: pojedynczo (kliknięcie) lub wielu (zaznaczenie powierzchniowe). 7. Aktywacja wczytywania rastrów po kliknięciu akcji „Aktywuj Wczytywanie” na pasku narzędzi. ENGLISH: For black and white data, create the dataset with black color set as transparent. Working only with RGB raster: GeoTIFF/TIFF, JPEG, JPEG2000, PNG, BMP, IMG (ERDAS), ECW, MrSID, NITF, HDF, NetCDF, GRIB, ASCII Grid, DEM, VRT. Supports georeference files: ("world files": geotiff, tfw, jgw, pgw, bpw, j2w, wld, prj, aux.xml) Functions: 1. Loading rasters: click, or click-and-drag to select an area (rectangle). 2. Setting transparency: white (255, 255, 255) by default; black (0, 0, 0) as an option. 3. Datasets saved in separate .txt files in the folder C:\Users\<user>\Documents\qzsit. 4. Copying all files sharing the same base name, without overwriting existing ones. 5. Change: The notification regarding the number of loaded, deleted, or copied rasters automatically disappears after 2 seconds and does not block workflow. 6. Deleting rasters: individually (by clicking) or multiple (by area selection). 7. Activating raster loading by clicking the "Activate Loading" action on the toolbar.

pyqgis_plugin.name: RS DAF Raster Download
pyqgis_plugin.description: Build Datafordeler download URLs from map extent, selection, or drawn rectangle (EPSG:25832).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Generates browser-pasteable URLs for Datafordeler raster/point-cloud file downloads. Requires your own Datafordeler API key.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Road Shortest Path
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive shortest path routing on LineString road network layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Road Shortest Path is a QGIS plugin for interactive shortest path routing on vector road networks. It allows users to calculate the shortest route between two points by clicking directly on the map. The plugin automatically snaps selected points to the nearest road segment and computes the optimal route using Dijkstra's algorithm. Features include two-click route creation, customizable route color, start and end markers, route length calculation, support for any LineString road network layer, and persistent plugin settings.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: network analysis,routing,shortest path,dijkstra,linestring,road network,route planner,route tester

pyqgis_plugin.name: Thermal Temperature Reconstructor
pyqgis_plugin.description:
EN: Thermal Temperature Reconstructor is a QGIS plugin that recovers temperature values from thermal orthomosaics generated via DJI FlightHub 2 cloud mapping, which lose radiometric data during processing. Using a reverse calculation based on the color palette and the min/max temperature scale set during the flight mission, it rebuilds a raster containing actual temperature values. Tested with the Rainbow ISO 2 palette on DJI Matrice 4TD and Matrice 400 (H30T) imagery.
IT: Thermal Temperature Reconstructor è un plugin QGIS che recupera i valori di temperatura dagli ortomosaici termici generati con il cloud mapping di DJI FlightHub 2, che perdono i dati radiometrici durante l'elaborazione. Tramite un calcolo a ritroso basato sulla palette colori e sulla scala di temperatura min/max impostata durante la missione di volo, ricostruisce un raster contenente i valori reali di temperatura. Testato con la palette Rainbow ISO 2 su immagini DJI Matrice 4TD e Matrice 400 (H30T).
pyqgis_plugin.about:
EN: The Thermal Temperature Reconstructor plugin allows the reconstruction of temperature values from maps created with DJI drones, such as the Matrice 4TD and Matrice 400 with H30T, processed in the cloud on the DJI FlightHub 2 platform (cloud mapping), generating a map containing the temperature values. Cloud mapping reconstructions, in fact, lose the radiometric temperature information.
The process is based on a reverse calculation of the color palette and of the maximum and minimum temperature values set in the temperature scale during the flight mission.
The color palette we tested the workflow with is Rainbow ISO 2; under normal conditions, the ideal temperature scale is 0 to 130 °C. The temperature scale must be adjusted for each mission to prevent the cloud from failing to correctly reconstruct the thermal map: since the output is an orthophoto, it is essential that the thermal images are as little monochromatic as possible. Do not leave the temperature scale in dynamic mode, otherwise you will never obtain correct data!
IT: Il plugin Thermal Temperature Reconstructor permette di ricostruire i valori di temperatura delle cartografie realizzate con droni DJI, come Matrice 4TD e Matrice 400 con H30T, elaborate in cloud sulla piattaforma DJI FlightHub 2 (cloud mapping), generando una mappa contenente i valori di temperatura. Le ricostruzioni in cloud mapping, infatti, perdono l'informazione radiometrica di temperatura.
Il processo si basa su un calcolo a ritroso della scala colori e dei valori di temperatura massima e minima impostati nella scala di temperatura durante la missione di volo.
La scala colori con cui abbiamo testato il flusso di lavoro è la Rainbow ISO 2; in condizioni normali, la scala di temperatura ideale è da 0 a 130 °C. La scala di temperatura deve essere adattata a ogni missione, per evitare che il cloud non riesca a ricostruire correttamente la mappa termica: trattandosi di un'ortofoto, è fondamentale che le foto termiche siano il meno monocromatiche possibile. Non lasciare la scala di temperatura in modalità dinamica, altrimenti non otterrai mai dati corretti!

pyqgis_plugin.name: Thermal to Polygon
pyqgis_plugin.description:
EN: Thermal to Polygon is a QGIS plugin that automatically extracts heat zones from thermal maps reconstructed with the Thermal Temperature Reconstructor plugin. By applying a temperature threshold, it creates a binary raster, polygonizes it, buffers and dissolves the results into a single polygon per zone, loaded with user-defined styling. Ideal for wildfire and mop-up monitoring, it helps quickly direct ground and airborne response teams where intervention is needed. Available in English, Italian, French and German.
IT: Thermal to Polygon è un plugin QGIS che estrae automaticamente le zone di calore dalle mappe termiche ricostruite con il plugin Thermal Temperature Reconstructor. Applicando una soglia di temperatura, crea un raster binario, lo poligonizza, genera buffer e dissolve i risultati in un unico poligono per zona, caricato con lo stile definito dall'utente. Ideale per il monitoraggio di incendi e bonifiche, aiuta a indirizzare rapidamente le squadre di intervento a terra e in aria dove è necessario intervenire. Disponibile in inglese, italiano, francese e tedesco.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
EN: The Thermal to Polygon plugin highlights heat zones through an automatic sequence of operations, to be run after the reconstruction performed with the Thermal Temperature Reconstructor plugin: once a temperature threshold has been selected using a mathematical operator, it creates a binary raster, polygonizes it, removes the polygons with a value of 0, generates a buffer around the polygons (with a selectable distance) and dissolves neighboring polygons, so as to obtain a single polygon per zone.
The polygon layer is loaded with the fill and outline color settings chosen before processing.
After the thermal reconstruction, this makes it possible to quickly highlight fire or mop-up areas, to follow the evolution of the event, and to promptly indicate to ground or airborne response teams where intervention is needed.
The plugin is available in English, Italian, French and German; the language can be forced via: Plugins → Thermal to Polygon → Plugin language.
IT: Il plugin Thermal to Polygon evidenzia le zone di calore attraverso una sequenza automatica di operazioni, da eseguire dopo la ricostruzione effettuata con il plugin Thermal Temperature Reconstructor: selezionata una soglia di temperatura tramite un operatore matematico, crea un raster binario, lo poligonizza, rimuove i poligoni con valore 0, genera un buffer attorno ai poligoni (con distanza selezionabile) e dissolve i poligoni vicini, in modo da ottenerne uno solo per zona.
Il layer di poligoni viene caricato con le impostazioni di colore di riempimento e perimetro scelte prima dell'elaborazione.
Questo permette, dopo la ricostruzione termica, di evidenziare rapidamente le zone di bonifica o di incendio, di seguire l'evoluzione dell'evento e di segnalare tempestivamente alle squadre di intervento, a terra o in aria, dove è necessario intervenire.
Il plugin è disponibile in inglese, italiano, francese e tedesco; la lingua può essere forzata da: Plugins → Thermal to Polygon → Lingua plugin.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Spatial Attribute Appender
pyqgis_plugin.description: Transfer attributes from a source layer to a target layer by spatial relationship (intersect/touch or nearest feature), with automatic field creation, optional Manual Field Mapping support, and undoable edits.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Spatial Attribute Transfer copies attributes (fields and values) from a source vector layer onto a target vector layer based on a spatial relationship. Two matching modes are available: Intersect/Touch and Nearest Feature (with an optional maximum search distance, powered by QgsSpatialIndex). By default, all matching fields are transferred automatically and missing fields are created in the target layer, preserving type, length and precision. An optional Field Mapping table lets you take manual control instead: Auto Match to pre-fill suggestions, then freely edit which source field goes to which target field, retarget a value to a differently named field, or create a brand-new target field on the fly. Geometries are never modified, and all changes happen inside an edit session grouped into a single undo command, so one Ctrl+Z reverts the whole transfer. Supports Point, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon and MultiPolygon layers, and handles differing CRSs via on-the-fly reprojection.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GPX Batch Converter
pyqgis_plugin.description: Batch-converts GPX layers to Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML or CSV, with optional merging, background processing, cancellation and detailed results.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GPX Batch Converter processes all GPX files in a selected folder and converts waypoints, routes, route points, tracks and track points to common GIS formats. Features include: * Batch conversion of GPX sublayers. * ESRI Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML and CSV/WKT output. * Optional merging into one output per GPX layer type. * Background execution through the QGIS Task Manager. * Safe cancellation of active GDAL operations. * Detailed results panel and UTF-8 CSV report export. * Source provenance fields in merged outputs. The plugin has no external Python package dependencies. It requires ogr2ogr and ogrinfo from the GDAL installation bundled with or available to the active QGIS environment. It is intended for Windows, Linux and macOS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: LayerCategoryLabel
pyqgis_plugin.description: Enhancement of QGIS core feature: automatically displays the classification field (or "Rules" for rule-based symbology) in the layer name.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Enhancement of QGIS core "Display classification attributes in layer titles" option. While QGIS hides classification field names under layer expansion arrows, this plugin displays them automatically in the layer name, making thematic layers immediately identifiable without extra clicks. Supports Categorized, Graduated and Rule-based symbology. Can be toggled on/off via toolbar icon.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GPS Road Builder (RidgeSlide)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Reconstructs a connected road/path network (graph) from raw GPS tracks using the RidgeSlide density method
pyqgis_plugin.about: GPS Road Builder reconstructs a connected road/path-network graph from raw GPS tracks of any kind — forestry haul roads, logistics, sports (running, cycling), off-road, vessels, OSM traces and more. Its core is RidgeSlide — a Python/NumPy/Numba density method conceived, generalized, developed and completed by Alexander Kobyakov (building on Guo et al. 2020 and the Slide method, with his own corrections and additions): build a density surface, compact trajectories onto road ridges, extract a centerline skeleton, then weight, clean and connect the edges. A KDE mode is available for very sparse data. Designed for large inputs (tens of millions of points) with background processing that keeps the QGIS UI responsive. Heavy optional accelerators (scikit-image, numba) are installed on demand from a dialog — no silent auto-install. Interface in 12 languages: Russian, English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, French, Portuguese, German, Indonesian, Thai and Vietnamese.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Jeomatik NCZ Reader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Imports NetCAD NCZ drawing files into QGIS and converts supported entities into editable vector layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Imports NetCAD NCZ drawing files directly into QGIS and converts supported entities into editable point, line, and polygon memory layers while preserving geometry and attributes. Designed for geomatics, surveying, engineering, and GIS professionals working with legacy or project-based NetCAD data.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Flood Simulation Studio
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive flood simulation and return-period flood assessment tools for QGIS 3.x and 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Flood Simulation Studio is a standalone QGIS workspace for planning-grade flood simulation and return-period screening. Load an AOI, optional buildings, optional soil/drainage/surface-water layers, or let the Studio fetch DEM, SoilGrids soil parameters, and mapped surface water. Set rainfall, infiltration, drainage, channels, blockages, and timing, then run an animated 2D/3D flood scenario or T5-T100 return-period assessments. Outputs include maximum and final flood depth, flood extent, hazard, speed and direction proxies, water-surface raster, affected-structure counts, CSV summaries, scenario JSON, and transferable DEM/soil/surface-water context layers. Engineering certification should use calibrated local hydrology and approved hydraulic solvers.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Curved & Polygon Text (For Layouts)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds advanced Curved Spline Text and Polygon Text Box items to the QGIS Layout Designer, complete with HTML rendering, drop shadows, and full formatting control.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Bridges a feature gap in the QGIS Print Layout engine by introducing two new layout item types:
* Curved Spline Text -- flows rich/HTML text along an editable, draggable editable cubic Bezier curve instead of a straight baseline. * Polygon Shaped Text Box -- wraps rich/HTML text to fit exactly inside an editable, draggable closed polygon outline with straight or cubic Bezier edges instead of a rectangle.
Both items support "Allow HTML Formatting" rich text (bold, italic, colour spans, etc.) and automatic evaluation of QGIS expressions written as [% ... %], exactly like the native Add Label item.
Requires QGIS 3.44 or later. The same codebase supports QGIS 3.44 LTR (PyQt5/Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (PyQt6/Qt6).
pyqgis_plugin.tags: text,layout,expression,html,curved text,cartography,atlas,spline,path text,polygon text,node editing,typography,print layout

pyqgis_plugin.name: Floating Info Tool
pyqgis_plugin.description: Hover over features to see their attributes in a modern floating popup, with clickable hyperlinks and multi-layer support.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A toolbar-toggled hover identify tool. When enabled, hovering over a feature on the active layer shows its attributes in a clean floating popup next to the cursor. Hold Ctrl while hovering to query the topmost visible vector layer under the cursor, regardless of which layer is active. Press Shift to pin the popup in place so hyperlinks (web URLs, file paths and UNC shares) become clickable, and Shift again (or Esc) to release it. The mouse wheel scrolls the popup when its content overflows instead of zooming the map. While pinned, footer buttons let you copy the displayed attributes as tab-separated text, copy the feature itself (geometry and attributes) onto the QGIS clipboard like Edit - Copy Features, or edit attribute values inline and save them back to the layer through an undoable edit command. Light and dark popup themes are available (auto-follows the QGIS interface theme by default). Field aliases are respected, fields hidden in the attribute form are not shown, and values are rendered through their editor widget formatters (value maps, dates, checkboxes). Works alongside the current map tool without replacing it.

pyqgis_plugin.name: LINZ Schema Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS Plugin/App to load New Zealand LINZ Data Service *.csv export data files directly into a MariaDB/MySQL database and create GIS map layers, relationships and styles for a full standalone off-line GIS mapping system for New Zealand.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS Plugin/Standalone App to manage a local MariaDB/MySQL database with New Zealand LINZ data. Options for database schema management, importing (*.csv) GIS data files, creating indexes and some predefined database views. Handles spatial and non-spatial *.csv files exported and downloaded from LINZ Data Service at https://data.linz.govt.nz/data/ Ability to create QGIS vector layers of the imported data. Options to define known relationships between tables and default symbology and labels for the map layers. A default New Zealand topographic style database is provided that can be loaded into a QGIS project and used to style topographical features. Unlike the "LINZ Data Importer" and "Koordinates" plugins, LINZ Schema Loader loads exported LINZ data directly into a local database without loosing data in large data-sets. LINZ Schema Loader is aimed for Database/GIS administrators and users wishing to build a mapping system for primarily New Zealand data. Requires Python modules for database access (eg. mariadb connector or MySQL connector)

pyqgis_plugin.name: SQL Database Mine
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS Plugin to mine related data from a SQL database server.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Mine data from selected features within a QGIS vector layer. Related data derived from a layer's Relationships and Joins can then be searched by selecting the required relationship. Once related data is searched, you can keep mining deeper with any further relationships. Where a vector layer is stored within a SQL database, the search is executed on the SQL database server, utilising the database indexes for rapid responses. If the related data has GIS features, these can be selected and zoomed into on the QGIS map. Rows of selected data can be copied into the clipboard for use in other applications. A query form is also included to enable SQL database searches and view the resulting features on the QGIS map. The inbuilt QGIS features to view table data loads and scans the layers full data, which is unusable for large datasets. SQL Database Mine performs the query on the database server and only deals with the resulting dataset. Requires Python module "sqlalchemy". This should be installed from your operating system distribution.

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02truesize - Map Truth Lab
pyqgis_plugin.description: Drag countries or downloaded ADM0/ADM1 administrative vectors anywhere to compare true size, grade projection honesty and explore geodesy.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Maps lie: every flat map must distort the globe, and the everyday web map (Mercator) inflates whatever sits far from the equator — Greenland is drawn like a continent yet Africa is about 14 times larger. 02truesize brings the much-loved thetruesize.com idea natively into QGIS and then goes further. The True Size tool lets you grab any country from the bundled offline world layer, any polygon from your own layers, or country-selected ADM0/ADM1 vectors, and drag it across the map; the outline is re-projected on the fly through an equal-area azimuthal projection centred under your cursor, so it always covers its true ground area. ADM0 comes instantly from the bundled world data; ADM1 is filtered from Natural Earth's official public-domain 10m states/provinces archive, downloaded once per panel session. Size Duel is a built-in game: 4 countries are drawn in a 2x2 grid with individual bounding box zoom and you guess which one is really the biggest — the plugin keeps score and confesses how much the projection lied each round. The Distortion tab features a Projection Recommender & Optimizer, CRS report card, Tissot indicatrix circles and live canvas HUD. Truth Tools adds an antipode finder, great-circle comparison, interactive 2D Origin-Destination (OD) Area Ratio Matrix dialog with CSV export, and single-file interactive HTML Map Truth Lab report exporter. The core remains dependency-free with pure-Python geodesy and native QGIS map tools. A playful, accurate companion for teaching projections, scale and spatial reasoning. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://geophilo.com/zero2truesize/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitLab (https://gitlab.com/geophilo1/zero2truesize)!

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02Urban Portrait - City as a Face
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create live urban portraits from built-in OSM downloads or project vectors, with luminance styling and print-ready export.
pyqgis_plugin.about: 02Urban Portrait transforms vector infrastructure into optical portraits, cartographic engravings, and graphic masks. Load a profile image, map it to a geographic frame, and style roads, buildings, points, or other vector layers from sampled pixel luminance without changing source geometries or attributes. Features interactive 3-stage visual workflow stepper with numbered circular badges, algorithmic vector stippling & halftone engraving generator, 10 curated artistic colorway presets with JSON import/export, prominent built-in OSM acquisition with live safety badges, live pan and zoom updates, and PNG/PDF/SVG export. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://geophilo.com/zero2urbanportrait/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitLab (https://gitlab.com/geophilo1/zero2urbanportrait)!

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02GeoQuest - Playable Map Studio
pyqgis_plugin.description: Turn any vector layer into a polished geography game, classroom challenge or public-engagement quest.
pyqgis_plugin.about: 02GeoQuest transforms ordinary QGIS vector layers into playful, useful challenges. Play Map Hunt directly on the QGIS canvas, compare attribute values, estimate distances, recognise polygon silhouettes, and test geodetic bearings in Compass Quest. Build mixed quests, import/export Quest Packs, keep local scoreboards, generate printable Achievement Certificates, and export standalone privacy-friendly HTML games that run fully offline. No account, API key, server or pip dependency is required. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://geophilo.com/zero2geoquest/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitLab (https://gitlab.com/geophilo1/zero2geoquest)!

pyqgis_plugin.name: Coordinate List Generator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Lists the coordinates of selected points, lines, and polygons under the desired heading in a projection system chosen by the user. Coordinates update automatically as the CRS is changed. Please do not hesitate to contact to report errors, problems, or suggestions. Thank you for your feedback and votes.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Coordinate List Generator lists the vertex coordinates of selected vector features (points, lines, and polygons) directly in a dockable panel, reprojected on the fly to any coordinate reference system you choose. Select a layer, pick an attribute field to use as the label for each feature, and select features on the map -- the list updates automatically whenever the selection or the target CRS changes. It works with multipart geometries and polygons with holes (interior rings listed separately), automatically calculates line length and polygon area in the target CRS (switching between metric units based on magnitude), and prompts for a second, distinctive field if several selected features share the same label value. A one-click "Copy Coordinates" button puts a tab-separated list on the clipboard ready to paste into Excel, and "Export to CSV" saves the full list (Label, Part, No, X, Y, Length, Cumulative Length, Heading, and Area) to a CSV file and opens it automatically. The panel automatically switches the map tool to feature selection when it opens, and back to Pan when it closes. Compatible with both QGIS 3 (PyQt5) and QGIS 4 (PyQt6).

pyqgis_plugin.name: ColorGPX
pyqgis_plugin.description: GPX轨迹按速度/高度/坡度渲染及批量处理工具，支持工程图层、单个或多个GPX和extensions扩展字段。 / Render and batch-process GPX tracks by speed, elevation or slope from project layers or one/many GPX files, including extension fields.
pyqgis_plugin.about: 提取GPX轨迹的速度、高程和坡度信息，生成点、线或渐变线图层并进行彩色化渲染。统一支持QGIS工程图层、单个/多个GPX及文件夹批量输入，提供字段预检查、模拟速度、临时/独立文件/单一GeoPackage输出和结果报告。 / Extracts and renders speed, elevation and slope from GPX tracks. Supports project layers, one or many GPX files, and folder batches through a unified queue with capability checks, simulated speed, temporary/separate/single-GeoPackage outputs, and result reports.

pyqgis_plugin.name: SuperLayer
