pyqgis_plugin.name: Isoliner3D
pyqgis_plugin.description: Standalone 3D viewer and bed/block-model toolset: surfaces, watertight bed bodies, boreholes, polyhedra, reserves. Автономный 3D-просмотр поверхностей, тел пластов, скважин и полиэдров, плюс подсчёт запасов по блочной модели.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A standalone 3D viewer for geological surfaces and bodies in QGIS, independent of the built-in 3D map. Renders project rasters as triangular-mesh surfaces (each horizon in its own colour, with vertical exaggeration and Z spacing), builds watertight bed bodies from multiband grids (band 1 roof, band 2 bottom), draws boreholes as coloured stems with collar masts and labels, shows a section plane with a bright section trace, and displays polyhedral / TIN / MultiPolygon Z bodies. Click-query prints layer name, coordinates, all band values and thickness. Colouring by palette, custom colour, own band, an external raster or a real map texture with shading: an orthophoto, a basemap or a styled geological map. A section drawing is draped onto the section ribbon, several sections at once. 22 Processing tools in two groups: the bed and block model computes thickness, volume and reserves from a bed grid, and the 3D interpolation builds cubes by kriging and multilevel B-splines, a bed grid from the outlines drawn on sections with the contact of neighbouring beds built as one surface, boolean operations on shells, selection by a shell and zonal statistics of shells. PNG snapshot for reports. A companion to the Isoliner kriging and contouring toolset (plugins.qgis.org/plugins/grid_isolines) and to Topoliner, topology cleaning (plugins.qgis.org/plugins/topoliner). pyqtgraph and PyOpenGL are bundled - nothing to install. Companion to the Isoliner kriging toolset. Developed with the support of Inform++ LLC (www.informpp.ru). . Автономный 3D-просмотр геологических поверхностей и тел в QGIS, не зависящий от штатного 3D-вида. Растры проекта рисуются треугольными мешами (каждый горизонт своим цветом, с вертикальным преувеличением и разносом по Z), из многоканальных гридов строятся водонепроницаемые тела пластов (канал 1 - кровля, канал 2 - подошва), скважины показываются цветными стволами с мачтами и подписями, плоскость разреза даёт яркий след сечения, а полиэдры / TIN / MultiPolygon Z отображаются объёмными телами. Клик по сцене печатает имя слоя, координаты, значения всех каналов и мощность. Окраска палитрой, своим цветом, собственным каналом, внешним растром или настоящей текстурой карты с затенением: ортофото, подложка, геологическая карта со своей символикой. На ленту разреза накладывается чертёж, несколько разрезов сразу. 22 инструмента Processing в двух группах: пласт и блочная модель считают мощность, объём и запасы по гриду пласта, а 3D-интерполяция строит кубы кригингом и мультисеточными B-сплайнами, грид пластов по зарисовкам на разрезах со склейкой контакта соседних пластов в одну поверхность, булевы операции с оболочками, выборку оболочкой и зональную статистику оболочек. Снимок PNG для отчётов. Спутник набора кригинга и изолиний Isoliner (plugins.qgis.org/plugins/grid_isolines) и чистки топологии Topoliner (plugins.qgis.org/plugins/topoliner). pyqtgraph и PyOpenGL идут в комплекте - устанавливать ничего не нужно. Спутник набора кригинга Isoliner. Разработано при поддержке ООО «Информ++» (www.informpp.ru).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Magic Search
pyqgis_plugin.description: FR: Une seule barre pour tout retrouver dans QGIS : tapez une adresse, un numero de regard ou des coordonnees, le plugin cherche en meme temps dans le geocodeur BAN/OSM et dans tous les champs de toutes les couches du projet. EN: One search bar to find anything in QGIS: type an address, an asset number or coordinates - the plugin searches the BAN/OSM geocoder and every field of every project layer at the same time. ES: Una sola barra para encontrarlo todo en QGIS: escriba una direccion, un numero de elemento o unas coordenadas y el complemento busca a la vez en el geocodificador BAN/OSM y en todos los campos de todas las capas del proyecto. PT: Uma unica barra para encontrar tudo no QGIS: escreva um endereco, um numero de elemento ou coordenadas e o modulo pesquisa ao mesmo tempo no geocodificador BAN/OSM e em todos os campos de todas as camadas do projeto. DE: Eine einzige Leiste, um in QGIS alles zu finden: Adresse, Objektnummer oder Koordinaten eingeben - die Erweiterung sucht gleichzeitig im BAN/OSM-Geocoder und in allen Feldern aller Projektebenen.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Recherchez simultanément dans les adresses (BAN pour la France, OSM/Nominatim dans le monde entier) et dans tous les champs de toutes les couches vectorielles de votre projet QGIS.
Deux styles d'interface au choix : barre flottante deplacable et redimensionnable posee sur le canevas, ou panneau ancrable Qt5.
Les resultats sont groupes par source, avec surbrillance de la geometrie au survol et zoom au clic.
L'indexation est incrementale et non bloquante, et le resultat est conserve dans un cache compresse stocke a cote du fichier projet, avec empreinte par couche pour ne reindexer que ce qui a change. Interface traduite en 5 langues (FR, EN, ES, PT, DE).
Auteur : Yoan Laloux - https://www.linkedin.com/in/ylaloux/
EN: Search simultaneously in addresses (BAN for France, OSM/Nominatim worldwide) and in every field of every vector layer of your QGIS project. Two UI styles: a draggable and resizable floating bar over the map canvas, or a dockable Qt5 panel. Results are grouped by source, with geometry highlighting on hover and zoom on click. Indexing is incremental and non-blocking, and is persisted in a compressed cache stored next to the project file, with a per-layer fingerprint so only changed layers are re-indexed. UI translated into 5 languages (FR, EN, ES, PT, DE). Author: Yoan Laloux - https://www.linkedin.com/in/ylaloux/ ES: Busque simultaneamente en direcciones (BAN en Francia, OSM/Nominatim en todo el mundo) y en todos los campos de todas las capas vectoriales de su proyecto QGIS. Dos estilos de interfaz: barra flotante o panel acoplable. Autor: Yoan Laloux - https://www.linkedin.com/in/ylaloux/ PT: Pesquise simultaneamente em enderecos (BAN na Franca, OSM/Nominatim em todo o mundo) e em todos os campos de todas as camadas vetoriais do seu projeto QGIS. Dois estilos de interface: barra flutuante ou painel acoplavel. Autor: Yoan Laloux - https://www.linkedin.com/in/ylaloux/ DE: Suchen Sie gleichzeitig in Adressen (BAN fur Frankreich, OSM/Nominatim weltweit) und in allen Feldern aller Vektorebenen Ihres QGIS-Projekts. Zwei Oberflachenstile: schwebende Leiste oder andockbares Panel. Autor: Yoan Laloux - https://www.linkedin.com/in/ylaloux/

pyqgis_plugin.name: HydroSuiteBM Pro
pyqgis_plugin.description: Hydrological Analysis Platform for QGIS — délimitation de bassins versants, calcul de leurs paramètres, temps de concentration (dont SCS-CN avec Assistant CN intégré), rapport PDF et export CSV.
pyqgis_plugin.about: HydroSuiteBM Pro délimite automatiquement un ou plusieurs bassins versants à partir d'un MNT (mode manuel par points exutoires, ou mode automatique découpant tout le MNT en sous-bassins), puis calcule leurs paramètres caractéristiques : géométrie (surface, périmètre, indice de compacité de Gravelius, rectangle équivalent), altimétrie (altitudes, courbe et intégrale hypsométrique, pente moyenne), réseau hydrographique (ordre de Strahler, densité de drainage, rapports de Horton), et temps de concentration selon cinq méthodes (Kirpich, Giandotti, Passini, Ventura, SCS/NRCS avec Curve Number). Un Assistant CN intégré permet de construire le raster Curve Number à partir de vos propres couches locales d'occupation du sol et de groupe hydrologique de sol (plutôt que de dépendre d'un jeu de données mondial automatique, de fiabilité variable selon les régions). Édition complète : génère un rapport PDF méthodologique et interprétatif (formules, domaines de validité, interprétation morphométrique automatique) et un export CSV des résultats, en plus des exports Shapefile (bassins et réseaux hydrographiques regroupés en une couche unique numérotée).

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoSort
pyqgis_plugin.description: Sort vector layer features by geometric and attribute criteria | Ordina le feature di un layer vettoriale per criteri geometrici e attributivi
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoSort sorts points, lines and polygons by centroid coordinates, area, length, vertex count, bounding box, distance from a configurable reference point, position along a line, a Hilbert curve (spatial sorting: nearby features stay nearby in the order), a serpentine/boustrophedon ordering for regular grids — horizontal (by Y, X alternating) or vertical (by X, Y alternating) bands, cross axis alternating band by band, the classic order for map series and survey/flight paths — and custom QGIS expressions. Supports hierarchical multi-criteria sorting (a secondary criterion breaks ties of the primary one) and both lexicographic and Natural Sort ordering for text and expression criteria (e.g. "11" < "1010" < "1111" instead of "1010" < "11" < "1111"). On geographic CRS (degrees) area, length, perimeter and distances are automatically measured on the ellipsoid (geodesic, in m²/m) — Auto/Always/Never modes available. It adds a progressive field (default 'sort_order', name/start value/step all customizable) to the layer or creates a new in-memory sorted layer. Also available in the Processing Toolbox for batch use and the graphical modeler. --- GeoSort permette di ordinare punti, linee e poligoni per coordinate centroide, area, lunghezza, numero di vertici, bounding box, distanza da punto di riferimento configurabile, posizione lungo una linea, una curva di Hilbert (ordinamento spaziale: le feature vicine nello spazio restano vicine nell'ordine), un ordinamento a serpentina/boustrophedon per griglie regolari — bande orizzontali (per Y, X alternato) o verticali (per X, Y alternato), asse trasversale alternato banda per banda, l'ordine classico per serie cartografiche e percorsi di rilievo/volo — ed espressioni QGIS personalizzate. Supporta l'ordinamento gerarchico multi-criterio (un criterio secondario spezza i pareggi del primario) e l'ordinamento lessicografico e Natural Sort per criteri testuali ed espressioni (es. "11" < "1010" < "1111" invece di "1010" < "11" < "1111"). Su CRS geografici (gradi) area, lunghezza, perimetro e distanze sono misurati sull'ellissoide (geodetica, in m²/m) — modalità Auto/Sempre/Mai. Aggiunge un campo progressivo (default 'sort_order', nome/valore iniziale/passo personalizzabili) al layer o crea un nuovo layer ordinato in memoria. Disponibile anche nel Processing Toolbox per uso in batch e nel modellatore grafico. --- Developed with the assistance of Claude Code (Anthropic) | Realizzato con l'ausilio di Claude Code (Anthropic)

pyqgis_plugin.name: G-CHAM Data Pack Builder
pyqgis_plugin.description: Builds Japanese G-CHAM data packs from Census, administrative, facility, transport, disaster, and basemap sources.
pyqgis_plugin.about: G-CHAM Data Pack Builder automates the creation of GIS-based Community Health Assessment Methods (G-CHAM) data packs for Japan. It downloads and integrates six 2020 Population Census 250 m mesh tables, 2026 N03 administrative boundaries, facility and transport datasets from National Land Numerical Information, GSI designated evacuation-site/shelter data, and J-SHIS probabilistic seismic-hazard information, and can add OpenStreetMap/GSI basemaps. Generated vector data are written as FlatGeobuf in the selected prefecture's JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular Coordinate System. The plugin handles Census suppression/aggregation, municipality allocation, derived age-group percentages, styling, labels, caching, and layer grouping. Road data are optional and disabled by default because downloads can be large. Spatial coverage is Japan. Internet access is required for source downloads and online map services. No external Python packages, API keys, user accounts, or personal information are required.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Change Describer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Compare two versions of any vector layer and get the differences written out in plain English — added, deleted and modified features, attribute changes field by field, and geometry edits measured as area, length or distance moved. Results come as a report table, a colour-coded change layer, a CSV file and an HTML summary.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
COMPARE TWO VERSIONS OF A LAYER AND SEE EXACTLY WHAT CHANGED Change Describer answers the question every GIS team asks sooner or later: what is different between this version of the data and the previous one? Instead of a raw diff, it produces readable sentences you can paste into a change log, a permit file, a QA report or an email.
Example of a generated description: "'height' changed from 12 to 15; 'zoning' gained: RES; geometry edited (area 1200.00 m2 -> 1350.00 m2, +150.00 m2)"
WORKS WITH ANY VECTOR LAYER Points, lines, polygons and attribute-only tables. Parcels and cadastral data, land use and zoning, utility networks, pipelines, addresses, survey points, habitats, assets, infrastructure inventories — any dataset that gets revised over time. The two versions may sit in different formats: a GeoPackage compared against a Shapefile, PostGIS against GeoJSON, a file downloaded today against last year's export.
HOW IT WORKS 1. Load both versions of the dataset into your QGIS project — the previous one and the current one. 2. Pick the field that identifies each feature (parcel number, asset ID, code). The plugin checks straight away whether the values are unique and complete in both layers, and tells you if they are not. 3. Tick the fields that matter. Fields holding a list of codes ("RES, COM, IND") can be marked as multi-value and are compared as sets, so reordering is not reported as a change. 4. Run it and read the report.
WHAT YOU GET - Report table: one row per change, with a ready-made English description, the list of changed fields and the measured geometry difference. - Change layer: only the features that changed, drawn on the map and colour-coded — green for added, red for deleted, cyan for modified. Deleted features keep their old geometry, so what disappeared is still visible. - CSV export: UTF-8 with BOM, opens correctly in Excel. - HTML summary: counts of added, deleted and modified features, which fields changed most often, and examples.
DETAILS THAT SAVE TIME - Features are matched by a field, not by feature order or internal ID, so re-saving a file does not break the comparison. - NULL, empty string and whitespace are treated as the same absent value, which keeps the report free of false positives. - Numeric tolerance for data that has been through a format that rounds values. - Optional case-insensitive matching for both keys and text values. - Geometry changes are described in fitting terms: area for polygons, length for lines, distance moved for points. Measurements use the project ellipsoid, so they are correct in any coordinate reference system.
TYPICAL USES Change detection and data versioning, quality control after a bulk edit or a data migration, verifying what a contractor delivered, documenting revisions of a plan or a permit drawing, building a change log for a dataset you publish regularly, and audit trails for regulated data.
REQUIREMENTS QGIS 3.22 or newer. No external software, accounts or API keys.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Terrain Product Studio
pyqgis_plugin.description: Publication-grade terrain maps from one DEM: 20 color palettes, USGS-style cartography, hydrology, geomorphometry, multi-hazard analysis, GeoPackage bundles, QGIS project export, 3D web viewers, restyle-without-regeneration and STL/OBJ print models.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Terrain Product Studio turns one elevation raster into a full set of publication-ready layers: elevation color relief, hillshades, slope, aspect, TRI/TPI, roughness, curvatures, spot elevations, smoothed contours and rivers, geomorphons, SPI/STI, landslide and multi-hazard indexes, hydrology, an all-in-one GeoPackage bundle, a ready-to-save .qgz project and an interactive 3D web viewer. The Assistant tab suggests smart defaults (contour interval, stream threshold, river width/depth, working CRS) from your DEM; cartography can be restyled onto existing canvas, QML and print layouts without re-running the pipeline. 20 color ramps in Light/Dark/Scientific, one-click industry presets, STL/OBJ 3D-print export and a run-history journal.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Fcloud Shizuoka
pyqgis_plugin.description: Shizuoka Prefecture Forest Cloud information viewer. Links forest planning map (GeoPackage) with the Shizuoka Forest Cloud API to display forest register details, protective forest records, and project data.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Displays forest information from the Shizuoka Prefecture Forest Cloud public system, linked to GeoPackage data created by Shinrinbo Code Converter. Provides a dock panel for browsing forest stand attributes, protective forest records, and forest management data. This plugin is specific to Shizuoka Prefecture. Requires a .gpkg or .shp layer containing a KEY1 field loaded in the QGIS project. The displayed information (protective forest ledger, Mori no Chikara reforestation project, forest management plans, forest land development, etc.) is sourced from open data published by Shizuoka Prefecture and the Shizuoka Prefecture Forest Cloud, retrieved, processed, and formatted for easy reference in QGIS. / Support: https://paypal.me/rawslnc

pyqgis_plugin.name: Yield Data Cleaner
pyqgis_plugin.description: Inspect, map, review, and non-destructively clean combine yield-monitor data one field at a time.
pyqgis_plugin.about: An open-source QGIS plugin for recognizing yield-monitor inputs, reviewing column mappings and coordinate reference systems, reconstructing harvest passes, executing non-destructive cleaning filters, generating portable Leaflet HTML reviews, and interoperating with AgGateway ADAPT Standard and vendor presets. Version 1.0.1 delivers official QGIS Plugin Repository and Qt6 compatibility updates, refined enum scoping, and security validation compliance.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GratisGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Browse, edit, and publish GratisGIS portal content from QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A native QGIS integration for GratisGIS, the open source self-hosted alternative to ArcGIS Online. Browse portal items from the QGIS Browser panel, search the portal, drag data layers and maps to the canvas, publish vector layers as portal data_layer items, publish PMTiles / GeoTIFF / MBTiles as tile_layer items, push QGIS edits back to portal-backed layers, clone layers for offline use, and publish the current QGIS project as a portal map. Private and org-shared layers render on the canvas via a read-only portal API key minted at sign-in and stored in the QGIS authentication database. Auth is OAuth + PKCE against the portal's Keycloak realm. No third-party Python dependencies. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later; see the bundled LICENSE file.

pyqgis_plugin.name: MiPlugins
pyqgis_plugin.description: Advanced GIS tools: surveying (Points/Tables to Polygons) and Google Earth Engine integration for DEM downloading.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Collection of QGIS tools: (1) Points to Polygons, (2) Table (CSV/XLS/XLSX) to Polygons with area calculation and vertex extraction. (3) Automated DEM downloading (SRTM, NASADEM, ALOS, MERIT) using the Google Earth Engine API, including dependency installation and authentication wizards.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QRouteCode
pyqgis_plugin.description: Converts vector lines and polylines into scannable Google Maps routing QR codes for mobile navigation.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin automatically extracts the explicit coordinate vertices of a selected polyline layer, shifts them to WGS 84, and encodes them directly into an URL-safe Google Maps Directions API schema. The routing coordinates are dynamically translated into a high-density, dark blue QR code preview frame inside QGIS. External dependency: Contains an embedded 'qrcode' source vendor library.

pyqgis_plugin.name: UA MBKD INFO
pyqgis_plugin.description: Open data on current urban planning documentation in Ukraine / Відкриті дані актуальної містобудівної документації України.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Після встановлення увімкніть плагін і скористайтеся панеллю «UA MBKD INFO». Режим ідентифікації ввімкнеться автоматично після додавання шару: клацніть об’єкт на карті, а якщо під курсором є кілька документів — виберіть потрібний зі списку. Щоб знову ввімкнути або вимкнути режим, натисніть кнопку «Ідентифікація МБКД» з іконкою курсора з «і». У картці документа можна переглянути й скопіювати відомості, перейти на сторінку Реєстру та завантажити межі документації як тимчасовий полігональний шар. Для виходу з режиму повторно натисніть «Ідентифікація МБКД» або виберіть інший шар. Із завантаженим точковим шаром містобудівної документації також можна використовувати безпосередньо стандартний інструмент QGIS «Ідентифікувати об’єкти». /After installation, enable the plugin and use the “UA MBKD INFO” toolbar. The identify mode is enabled automatically after the layer is added: click a feature on the map, and if several documents overlap under the cursor, select the required one from the list. To enable or disable the mode again, click the “Identify MBKD” button with the cursor-and-“i” icon. In the document card, you can view and copy information, open the Registry page, and load the documentation boundaries as a temporary polygon layer. To exit the mode, click “Identify MBKD” again or select another layer. You can also use the standard QGIS “Identify Features” tool directly with the loaded urban planning documentation point layer.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Aeternum Aquae - Estaciones Climatológicas (México)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Query and spatial extraction of Mexican climatological stations from Supabase with buffer analysis, attribute selection, and dynamic IDF curve computation.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Complemento para QGIS desarrollado para facilitar la consulta y el procesamiento de información de estaciones climatológicas de México mediante una base de datos pública alojada en Supabase. Permite localizar y filtrar estaciones por estado, municipio o polígono de proyecto, establecer áreas de influencia mediante buffers, seleccionar variables climatológicas específicas y realizar el cálculo de intensidades de precipitación mediante curvas IDF. El desarrollo y la metodología implementada se fundamentan en la investigación "Mass Processing of Mexican Climatological Stations" de Pérez, A. R. (2026), disponible en OSF (https://osf.io/ar6x3).

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoSIG
pyqgis_plugin.description: GeoSIG Plugin: Multiple Buffer Tool.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Celular: 995664488 | Web: www.geomatica.pe | Plugin con herramienta de Multiple Buffer para puntos, lineas y poligonos, permitiendo multiples distancias y disolver resultados.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Map Extent QR
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate QR codes containing the geographic extent of a QGIS Print Layout and georeference exported map images by reading the QR code embedded in the image.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Map Extent QR adds a QR code to a QGIS Print Layout containing the geographic coordinates of the full exported layout. The plugin can read the QR code from an exported map image and create a georeferenced image in QGIS. The local QR reader does not require additional Python packages. If local decoding fails, an optional online QR-reading fallback is used and requires an internet connection.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Kiểm tra CSDL GIS
pyqgis_plugin.description:
Kiểm tra hồ sơ GIS quy hoạch đô thị và nông thôn theo Thông tư 16/2025/TT-BXD (Phụ lục II): cấu trúc hồ sơ, nhóm dữ liệu chuyên đề, lớp dữ liệu, trường thuộc tính, hình học/topology và hệ tọa độ VN-2000. Inspects GIS data submissions for urban and rural planning in accordance with Circular 16/2025/TT-BXD (Appendix II): dataset structure, thematic data groups, data layers, attribute fields, geometry/topology, and the VN-2000 coordinate system.
How to use the plugin: You can upload one or more .gdb files to check the database structure against Circular 16 of the Ministry of Construction, as well as to check geometry. For any arbitrary .gdb, you only need to enable the geometry check.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Created by Hoa Le. Plugin rà soát cơ sở dữ liệu số địa lý (HoSoGIS) của đồ án quy hoạch, đọc dữ liệu từ File Geodatabase (*.gdb): kiểm tra 04 cơ sở dữ liệu chính (NenDiaHinh, HienTrang, QuyHoach, MocGioi), các nhóm dữ liệu chuyên đề, tên và kiểu hình học của lớp dữ liệu, các trường thuộc tính tối thiểu (maThongTinQH, maHoSoQH, maDoiTuong, tenDoiTuong, phanLoai, ghiChu), bộ 10 quy tắc hình học/topology có mã (G00-G03, P01, L02, L04, A01-A03) cho phép phóng tới từng đối tượng lỗi trên bản đồ, và hệ tọa độ VN-2000. Kết quả xuất được ra HTML và CSV. Giấy phép: GPL-2.0-or-later.
Created by Hoa Le. This plugin reviews the geospatial database (HoSoGIS) of a planning project, reading data from a File Geodatabase (*.gdb). It validates the 04 main databases (NenDiaHinh, HienTrang, QuyHoach, MocGioi), the thematic data groups, the names and geometry types of data layers, the minimum required attribute fields (maThongTinQH, maHoSoQH, maDoiTuong, tenDoiTuong, phanLoai, ghiChu), a set of 10 coded geometry/topology rules (G00–G03, P01, L02, L04, A01–A03) that allow zooming to each error feature on the map, and the VN-2000 coordinate system. Results can be exported to HTML and CSV. License: GPL-2.0-or-later.

pyqgis_plugin.name: SATHI
pyqgis_plugin.description: SATHI: Spatial Aggregation, Temporal Harmonization & Interpolation for geometry-aware climate-grid extraction, spatial statistics, interpolation and daily-to-seasonal harmonization.
pyqgis_plugin.about: SATHI (Spatial Aggregation, Temporal Harmonization & Interpolation) is a QGIS climate-grid processing plugin for Raster/NetCDF, Vector Layer and CSV inputs. It supports nearest-neighbour and bilinear interpolation, Point/Line/Polygon Spatial Mean and geometry-weighted Mean, automatic field/NetCDF variable detection, leap-year-aware Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Seasonal harmonization, rainfall SUM and temperature MEAN rules, NoData exclusion, and AOI-wise wide CSV outputs. SATHI v1.9.7 groups year-wise NetCDF and CSV folder inputs by climate variable: TMAX, TMIN, Rainfall and similar variables each produce one multi-year CSV per selected temporal period, with one row per year. First-level variable subfolders such as TMAX/2020.nc are recognized automatically. Rainfall groups use SUM and temperature groups use MEAN in Auto mode. TIFF/IMG raster folders and Vector Layer folders remain source-separated, and raster pixel-overlay mode remains one CSV per raster source. The Grid input type label is Vector Layer. SATHI v1.9.5 added a raster-vector pixel overlay mode containing every valid intersecting raster pixel with Latitude, Longitude, PixelValue and per-group Min/Max/Mean/Sum statistics. SATHI v1.9.4 adds native GDAL multidimensional NetCDF reading of TIME/LATITUDE/LONGITUDE coordinates and an IMD 0.25-degree documented-grid fallback when classic raster sampling returns no valid pixels. SATHI v1.9.3 added explicit raster Time/Date and Pixel Value handling for TIFF/IMG and other rasters: dates are detected from filenames or per-band metadata, raster pixel values are sampled directly, and Auto band selection distinguishes true dated time stacks from ordinary multiband imagery. SATHI v1.9.2 added robust NetCDF date-axis decoding and GDAL-direct fallback sampling so valid climate stacks are not lost when the QGIS raster provider returns empty samples. SATHI v1.9.1 added a responsive, resizable popup layout with scrollable controls, adaptive branding, flexible processing/output controls and a responsive Help window. SATHI v1.9.0 added expanded raster file/folder support, QGIS-provider file filters, and Point, Line and Polygon AOI processing. Polygon weighted means use overlap area, Line weighted means use intersection length, and Point AOIs use containing/nearest grid cells. One-decimal output formatting, interactive logo/help, climate aggregation rules and wide CSV outputs are retained.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Mr. Akmaul Hoque, Dr. Manish Kumar Naskar, Dr. Debasish Charaborty, Dr. Koushik Bag

pyqgis_plugin.name: VHRHarmonize
pyqgis_plugin.description: Run VHR satellite imagery preprocessing workflows from QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.about: vhrharmonize is an open-source Python library, CLI, and QGIS plugin suite for preprocessing very high resolution (VHR) satellite imagery into analysis-ready products.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Bhoonidhi Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Search, browse and download open-access satellite imagery from ISRO's Bhoonidhi portal directly inside QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A QGIS front-end for the bhoonidhi-downloader library (https://github.com/geovicco-dev/bhoonidhi-downloader, MIT license). Log in with your Bhoonidhi credentials (never stored to disk -- the session lives only in memory for the current QGIS session and is discarded on close), pick a direct-download satellite/sensor, set a date range and a spatial filter (manual bounding box or a drawn rectangle), search the archive, preview georeferenced scene quicklooks on the map, and download selected scenes. Each search is saved as a revisitable "query" for the session and cleaned up automatically when QGIS closes. External dependency: the bhoonidhi-downloader PyPI package (needs Python 3.10+, i.e. QGIS 3.34 or newer). The plugin installs it automatically with pip into your user Python folder the first time it runs (internet needed, no admin rights) and confirms with an "All dependencies resolved" message. If that fails it tells you why and how to install it manually; the plugin re-checks each time QGIS starts (or you click its toolbar icon) and tries again automatically. Works with QGIS 3.34 through 4.x.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Add Transparency Slider
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds an 'Add / Remove transparency slider' item to the layer tree context menu to quickly manage embedded opacity sliders beneath layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds a convenient context menu action in the QGIS layer panel to conditionally add or remove the embedded transparency (opacity) slider for map layers with a single click.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Observatorio Forestal UTN
pyqgis_plugin.description: Institutional QGIS plugin of the UTN Forest Observatory (Universidad Técnica del Norte - Ecuador) for active wildfire monitoring, historical fire queries, satellite imagery (Sentinel-2, Landsat), global digital elevation models (Copernicus DEM GLO-30), Google Earth-style interactive Elevation Profile, high-resolution base maps, WorldClim 2.1 global climatology, ESA WorldCover 10m V2, SoilGrids250m 2.0 (ISRIC), Meteograma (Open-Meteo multi-panel weather & fire risk forecasting and ERA5 reanalysis), Coordenadas EC tools, and AI geospatial assistant (MCP).
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Specialized geospatial tools from the UTN Forest Observatory (Universidad Técnica del Norte - Ecuador) for active wildfire monitoring, historical fire analysis, satellite imagery, global digital elevation models, Google Earth-style Elevation Profile, WorldClim 2.1 global climatology, ESA WorldCover 10m V2, SoilGrids250m 2.0 (ISRIC), Meteograma (Open-Meteo NWP & ERA5 reanalysis), cartographic base mapping, Coordenadas EC tools, and AI-assisted GIS workflows.
**Problem Solved:** Provides forestry researchers, emergency responders, and GIS specialists with immediate access to near-real-time wildfire alerts, historical multi-sensor fire archives, global 30m digital elevation models (Copernicus DEM GLO-30), interactive Google Earth-style topographic elevation profiling with real-time map marker synchronization, multi-panel meteorological forecasting and fire danger index charts (HDWI, HCFM, PBL, wind vectors via Open-Meteo ECMWF/GFS/ERA5), WorldClim 2.1 bioclimatic variables (BIO01-BIO19) and monthly climatology, ESA WorldCover 10m V2 land cover, SoilGrids250m 2.0 digital soil mapping (carbon, pH, nitrogen, textures, density), Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) satellite data, Coordenadas EC tools for official Ecuador coordinate reference systems (EPSG:4326 and EPSG:32717), and AI assistance directly inside QGIS without manual downloading or complex API setup.
**Data Sources and Services:** - **Active and Historical Wildfires:** NASA FIRMS (MODIS and VIIRS) near-real-time thermal anomaly hotspots and custom multi-temporal historical queries via NASA FIRMS API with 8-step temporal symbology, fire radiative power (FRP) classification, automatic project reprojection to EPSG:4326, Ecuador extent auto-framing, and 5-minute background auto-refresh. - **Meteograma y Pronóstico (Open-Meteo):** Multi-panel interactive weather & fire risk forecasting dialog (HDWI, HCFM dead fuel moisture, dry hours, PBL boundary layer height, wind barbs, rain & probability) supporting ECMWF IFS 0.25°, NOAA GFS, DWD ICON, and ERA5 historical reanalysis with map picking, FIRMS hotspot capture, high-res PNG (300 DPI) and CSV export. - **Perfil de Elevación (Google Earth Style):** Dynamic, interactive 2D topographic elevation profile docked at bottom with real-time map synchronization. Samples Copernicus DEM GLO-30 or any DEM raster; supports interactive canvas drawing or existing line layers; displays full metrics (Min/Avg/Max elevation, total distance, +/- elevation gain/loss, +/- slopes); exports PNG and CSV. - **Coordenadas EC (Official Ecuador CRS):** Conversion of Excel and CSV tables to point layers with dual coordinates, point attribute table coordinate updates (Long/Lat EPSG:4326 with 6 decimals and East/North EPSG:32717 with 2 decimals), and polygon/line vertex extraction with distances, area, and perimeter calculations. - **Satellite Imagery and DEM:** Direct search and streaming of Sentinel-2 L2A (10m), Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 (30m), and Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30m) via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API with automated AOI selection (Canvas, 24 Ecuador Provinces), multi-band RGB compositions, and spectral indices (NDVI, NBR, NBR2, NDWI, NDMI, EVI). - **SoilGrids250m 2.0 (ISRIC World Soil Information):** Subcategoría Suelo para descarga, recorte y visualización científica de 10 propiedades edafológicas (SOC, OCS stock 0-30cm, pH en agua, nitrógeno total, arcilla, limo, arena, densidad aparente, CEC, fragmentos gruesos) a 6 profundidades estándar (0-5cm a 100-200cm) con SRC predeterminado EPSG:4326. - **WorldClim 2.1 Global Climatology:** Direct download and automated AOI clipping for 19 Bioclimatic variables (BIO01 to BIO19) and monthly climatological series (tmin, tmax, tavg, prec, srad, wind, vapr, elev) at 30 arc-seconds (~1 km) resolution. - **Base Maps:** High-resolution XYZ satellite, vector, and topographic tiles (Google Hybrid, Google Road, Bing Satellite, OpenStreetMap Standard, OpenTopoMap, and Esri: Imagery, Imagery Hybrid, Streets, Topographic, Navigation, Streets Night) automatically placed at the bottom of the layer stack. - **AI Assistant (MCP):** Built-in Model Context Protocol socket server (port 9876, auto-start) connecting QGIS with Google Antigravity for autonomous GIS analysis and geoprocessing.
**Requirements:** Active internet connection for streaming remote STAC, WFS, and XYZ tile services. Zero external Python dependencies required (100% native PyQGIS and standard Python library).
**License:** GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPLv3).
Official web platform: https://observatorioforestal.utn.edu.ec/
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: PhD. Oscar Hernando Eraso Terán (Research Professor — Universidad Técnica del Norte, Ecuador)

pyqgis_plugin.name: Sumo Cable Name Via ACT Count FTTH
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate cable naming alphabet values from ACT Count field.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Select a layer and field. The plugin sorts records and automatically populates the Alphabet field based on ACT Count values.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Net2INP
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create EPANET .inp networks from line/multilinestring layers or XYZ CSV data
pyqgis_plugin.about: Net2INP simplifies creation of EPANET hydraulic models from GIS data. Select interconnected line or MultiLineString layers (shapefiles, GPKG, etc.); the plugin detects junctions, calculates pipe lengths, applies default or attribute-based properties (diameter, roughness, elevation, demand), optionally samples junction elevations from a DEM, and splits pipes at intermediate nodes, and writes a complete .inp file with [JUNCTIONS], [PIPES], [COORDINATES], [VERTICES] and more. Also import node/link networks from XYZ CSV and optionally designate reservoirs or tanks. Preview, highlight, and export ready-to-run EPANET models.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Vernier
pyqgis_plugin.description: Vector editing toolkit: smart snapping, topology validation, polygon splitting to exact areas, attribute and spatial joins, DXF/DWG and KMZ exchange, autosave backups, and an optional CAD Mode with a typed command bar.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Vernier is a vector editing toolkit for QGIS.
The toolbox adds a one-click snapping profile, a topology validator that outputs styled error layers, topology-aware Remove Close Vertices, Find Duplicate Geometries, polygon splitting to exact target areas, polygon centerline (medial axis) extraction, styled DXF/DWG import and DXF export with labels, multi-layer KMZ export with label placemarks, attribute and spatial joins, quick symbology templates, versioned autosave backups with a restore browser, and a live area readout for selected polygons.
CAD Mode (off by default) adds a typed command bar with autocomplete, a dark canvas with a scalable grid, and a live status strip. It follows the workspace conventions shared by AutoCAD, BricsCAD, ZWCAD, GstarCAD, DraftSight and other DWG/DXF software, and the import/export tools read and write drawings from any of them.
EXTERNAL DEPENDENCIES - all core tools run on a stock QGIS with no extra packages. Only these optional tools need more:
* DXF import/export needs the 'ezdxf' Python package. The plugin offers a one-click, consent-based install into a private folder of the QGIS user profile - never into the QGIS installation, and never without asking. The profile folder is used so the package survives plugin updates. It can also be installed manually with 'python -m pip install ezdxf' from the OSGeo4W Shell on Windows or your system Python on Linux/macOS. * Centerline extraction uses 'shapely', which already ships with QGIS. * DWG (not DXF) import needs the free ODA File Converter, installed separately by the user. The plugin only locates it on disk and never downloads it.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ArtefactJugaad
pyqgis_plugin.description: Corrects localized raster artefacts using reference raster replacement or interpolation while preserving the original raster grid.
pyqgis_plugin.about: ArtefactJugaad is a practical raster correction tool for QGIS that identifies user-defined artefact regions and reconstructs their values using either a reference raster or interpolation from surrounding valid pixels. The tool supports multiple artefact polygons and treats the Raster to Correct as the master grid, preserving its CRS, pixel size, dimensions, spatial extent and grid alignment. It is designed for DEMs, remote sensing products, terrain datasets, interpolated surfaces and other gridded raster data.

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02CartoLab
pyqgis_plugin.description: Unified cartographic studio and print layout automation for QGIS: publication-grade thematic styling, bivariate maps, 2.5D extrusion, and one-click layout generation with template gallery, custom graticules, and map book atlas automation.
pyqgis_plugin.about: 02CartoLab is a unified thematic mapping and print layout automation studio for QGIS. It bridges map symbology and publication print layouts in one cohesive workflow: builds publication-ready choropleths (including bivariate and Value-by-Alpha), continuous-area cartograms, ridge-line relief maps, dot-density and Flannery proportional-symbol maps, hexbin aggregation, and native 2.5D building styling - then assembles complete print layouts (with template gallery, legend, scale bar, north arrow, coordinate graticules, and credits) in one click. Includes an embedded Layout Designer studio dock, automated multi-page map book atlas engine, CVD accessibility inspector, and a comprehensive Processing provider. No external dependencies - pure QGIS. Online Documentation: https://geophilo.com/zero2cartolab/ | Repository: https://github.com/YusufEminoglu/zero2cartolab

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS 2.5D Styling
pyqgis_plugin.description: Focused 2.5D building styler with OSM footprints, per-floor colors, 10 themes, three renderers, presets, and QML workflows.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS 2.5D Styling performs one focused task: producing publication-ready 2.5D building symbology. Use an existing polygon layer or explicitly download bounded OSM building footprints. OSM building:levels values drive floor counts; missing values use a visible, configurable three-floor default. The compact right dock provides three renderers, projection and material controls, 10 curated 02CartoLab-derived themes, 23 per-floor palettes (each theme's own matching gradient plus 13 standalone palettes), live preview, previous-style restoration, and QML import/export. A single Processing algorithm applies styling headlessly. No pip dependencies are required. Repository: https://gitlab.com/geospacephilo/qgis_25d_styling

pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: CAD Fillet & Chamfer suite with Interactive vertex rounding, Two-Line merge, Corner Restoration, and Batch processing for QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Dedicated CAD Fillet & Chamfer toolkit for QGIS 3.16-4.99 providing interactive vertex rounding/chamfering, Two-Line merge with attribute preservation, Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet/Unchamfer), and Batch Fillet & Chamfer processing. Fully supports QGIS snapping, metric/geographic CRS units, Z/M coordinates, atomic undo/redo, and top-right HUD panels on Qt5 and Qt6.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Kriging Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Ordinary & Universal Kriging with variogram diagnostics for the Processing Toolbox
pyqgis_plugin.about: Kriging Tools brings professional geostatistical interpolation to the QGIS Processing Toolbox. It offers Ordinary and Universal Kriging powered by pure Python (PyKrige + scikit-gstat), with automatic variogram fitting, diagnostic plots, cross-validation metrics, anisotropy support, optional masks, and uncertainty rasters. No SAGA or other external binaries are required.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: William Bright Asomani and Shalom Adjei-Yeboah

pyqgis_plugin.name: QEHT Engineering Hydrology
pyqgis_plugin.description: In-process terrain, drainage-network and catchment analysis for engineering hydrology. Equivalent to commercial reference hydrology/raster toolsets, with no external executables.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A security-conscious QGIS plugin providing terrain, drainage-network and watershed analysis equivalent to commercial reference hydrology and raster toolsets.
All computation runs IN-PROCESS using only the NumPy and GDAL libraries already bundled with QGIS. The plugin never spawns a child process, never calls gdal_polygonize.exe, saga_cmd.exe or the GRASS batch wrappers, and requires no pip installation. This makes it usable on managed workstations where endpoint security blocks subprocess execution from GUI applications.
Tools: Fill depressions, D8 flow direction, flow accumulation, stream network with Strahler ordering, catchment delineation with pour-point snapping, and longest flow path with length/drop/slope for time-of- concentration calculations.
Flow direction uses steepest descent weighted by distance and is written in the standard D8 1/2/4/.../128 encoding, so grids interchange directly with commercial reference GIS and hydrology toolsets in both directions.
Licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Global DEM Portal
pyqgis_plugin.description: Select 1°x1° tiles on a map and download nine free global DEMs (SRTM, NASADEM, ALOS, Copernicus, Mapzen, ANADEM, GEDTM30) straight into QGIS - no account, no API key.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Wraps the Global DEM Portal web app (https://globaldemportal.github.io) as a dockable QGIS plugin. Pick a DSM/DTM source, select tiles by click, rectangle, polygon, country search or an existing QGIS layer, and download. Tiles come from the OpenTopography public mirror (and the AWS terrain-tiles bucket for Mapzen) anonymously - no Earthdata login and no API key. Downloads are intercepted, unzipped/gunzipped as needed and added to the map as raster layers.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS CAD Sync
pyqgis_plugin.description: Bidirectional DWG and DXF conversion for QGIS, with a background sync tool that keeps a QGIS layer updated automatically when the file is saved in AutoCAD.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin provides two separate tools.
The first tool is file conversion. It requires ODA File Converter, which must be installed separately (free, from opendesign.com). Four Processing algorithms are added under Processing Toolbox, DWG / DXF Conversion: Convert DWG file to DXF, Bulk convert DWG folder to DXF, Convert DXF file to DWG, and Bulk convert DXF folder to DWG. Bulk conversions skip files that were already converted by default, so they are safe to run again. The input folder is checked before conversion starts, a timeout prevents the process from hanging, and any files that fail to convert are reported by name. Successful DXF results can be added to the current project automatically. These algorithms can be run from the Processing Toolbox, from qgis_process, from Processing models, or from PyQGIS scripts.
The second tool is Live Sync. It does not require ODA File Converter and works on its own for anyone saving DXF files directly from AutoCAD. It is a dockable panel that watches DXF files on disk and reloads the matching QGIS layer automatically whenever AutoCAD saves changes. It loads from a temporary copy of the file rather than the original, so AutoCAD is never blocked from saving. It waits for the file to finish writing before reading it, supports pausing and manual sync, can keep a version history, logs all activity, shows the sync status of each file, and saves the watch list in the QGIS project so it is restored automatically the next time the project is opened.
The plugin works on QGIS 3.x and 4.x, on Windows, macOS, and Linux. On headless Linux, xvfb is required for the conversion algorithms only. Developed by Kelvin Moseti.

pyqgis_plugin.name: CanaPlan – Réseau Assainissement
pyqgis_plugin.description: Dessin topologique de réseaux EU (rouge), EP (bleu) et eau potable AEP (cyan, symboles StaR-Eau) : conduites, branchements, regards, tabourets, nœuds et compteurs. PILOTABLE PAR SCRIPT AUTANT QU'À LA SOURIS — point d'entrée : from CanaPlan.tools import api ; api.aide() — chaque outil est un verbe Python, et des recettes JSON jouent un chantier complet (projet, fonds, tracé sur axe OSM, un branchement par habitation, terrain naturel sur MNT IGN, cotes, plan PDF) en un seul appel, sans aucun clic. Profils en long, cubatures, coupes, impression PDF multi-feuilles, export DXF et export GeoPackage StaR-Eau (CNIG/ASTEE). En France comme à l'international : adresses et bâti OpenStreetMap, photo aérienne Esri, système UTM contrôlé hors de France. [EN] Topological drawing of foul (red) and storm (blue) sewer networks and drinking-water (AEP, cyan, StaR-Eau symbols) networks: pipes, service connections, manholes, inspection chambers, nodes and meters. FULLY SCRIPTABLE, NOT A MOUSE-ONLY TOOL — entry point: from CanaPlan.tools import api ; api.aide() — every tool is a Python verb, and JSON recipes run a complete job (project, basemaps, centreline from OSM, one connection per dwelling, ground level from the national DEM, levels, PDF plan) in a single call. Longitudinal profiles, trench volumes, cross sections, multi-sheet PDF printing, DXF export and StaR-Eau (CNIG/ASTEE) GeoPackage export.
pyqgis_plugin.about: CanaPlan est un logiciel de dessin projet qui permet de tracer des réseaux d'assainissement EU (Eaux Usées) et EP (Eaux Pluviales) directement dans QGIS, sur un fond de carte importé directement par le plugin (BAN, cadastre PCI, orthophoto IGN, OSM, ou plan DXF/DWG existant), avec continuité géométrique native : chaque conduite relie deux ouvrages, chaque branchement se recale automatiquement sur sa conduite mère quand elle bouge, avec validation à l'enregistrement. La pente du réseau peut être définie ou rectifiée directement avec les outils de dessin et de saisie (assistant de création de projet en 4 étapes, tableau de saisie groupée). L'outil produit les profils en long (EU/EP/groupé), calcule les volumes de cubature (déblai et matériaux de remblai rapportés), génère des coupes de tranchée transversales, imprime les plans au format PDF multi-feuilles orientables avec plan d'ensemble et permet d'exporter en DXF 2018 fidèle. Du relevé terrain jusqu'à la livraison, un seul outil couvre toute la chaîne : import Star-DT / StaR-Elec (DT-DICT), fonds de plan IGN/BAN/PCI chargés en tâche de fond, et export GeoPackage conforme au géostandard StaR-Eau V2024 (CNIG/ASTEE).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Konwerter CAD na GIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Konwersja rysunków AutoCAD DWG/DXF, DGN, GML, KML/KMZ, GeoJSON, CSV/TSV, SpatiaLite, GPX, geobaz GDB i MS Access do warstw GeoPackage z gotową polską symbolizacją planistyczną (MPZP, plan ogólny, GESUT, EGiB) oraz eksport z QGIS do DXF, GML, KML i KMZ. / Converts CAD and GIS datasets into styled GeoPackage layers with Polish planning symbology, and exports back to DXF, GML, KML and KMZ (Polish UI).
pyqgis_plugin.about:
*** ENG description below ***
NARZĘDZIE W CAŁOŚCI PO POLSKU Wtyczka zamienia rysunki CAD i pliki wymiany danych na gotowe warstwy QGIS — od razu pokolorowane zgodnie z polskimi przepisami planistycznymi i geodezyjnymi. Nie wymaga żadnych dodatkowych programów ani kont: wszystko robi sama, na tym, co jest w QGIS-ie.
CO WCZYTUJE: - rysunki AutoCAD DXF (*.dxf) i DWG (*.dwg), - Microstation DGN (także wersję 8, własnym czytnikiem), - GML — w tym zbiory danych przestrzennych aktów planowania przestrzennego (APP) i dane z usług INSPIRE, - KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, - CSV/TSV z automatycznym wykrywaniem kolumn X/Y albo geometrii WKT, - SpatiaLite/SQLite, GPX, geobazy ArcGIS (.gdb) i bazy MS Access.
CO ZAPISUJE: - GeoPackage (.gpkg) — jeden plik z wszystkimi warstwami i symbolizacją, - warstwy tymczasowe albo podgląd na żywo, bez konwersji, - eksport w drugą stronę: warstwa z QGIS do DXF (powrót do CAD-a), GML 3.2 (wymiana danych, INSPIRE, APP — razem z plikiem schematu .xsd), KML i KMZ.
POLSKA SYMBOLIZACJA (nadawana automatycznie): - MPZP — przeznaczenia terenów wg rozporządzenia Ministra Infrastruktury z 26 sierpnia 2003 r. w sprawie wymaganego zakresu projektu miejscowego planu (MN, MW, U, US, UC, P, R, RM, ZL, ZP, WS, KD, KDW i pozostałe), z kreskowaniami dla oznaczeń mieszanych, - PLAN OGÓLNY GMINY — 13 stref planistycznych (SW, SJ, SZ, SU, SH, SP, SR, SI, SN, SC, SG, SO, SK) w kolorach RGB podanych wprost w rozporządzeniu Ministra Rozwoju i Technologii z 8 grudnia 2023 r. (Dz.U. 2023 poz. 2758, zał. nr 2), wraz z obszarami POG, OSD, OZS i OUZ, - GESUT / mapa zasadnicza — sieci uzbrojenia terenu w barwach branżowych (wodociągowa niebieska, kanalizacyjna brązowa, gazowa żółtooliwkowa, elektroenergetyczna czerwona, ciepłownicza fioletowa, telekomunikacyjna pomarańczowa), - EGiB — działki, budynki, użytki, osnowa, granice obrębów i granice administracyjne.
JAK PRACUJE: - przeciągnij plik na panel albo wskaż go przyciskiem, - obejrzyj listę warstw w pliku i odznacz to, czego nie potrzebujesz, - wybierz układ współrzędnych — wtyczka sama rozpoznaje polskie układy państwowe (PUWG 2000 strefy 5-8, PUWG 1992, WGS 84) po samych współrzędnych, - wskaż rodzaj opracowania (MPZP, plan ogólny, GESUT, EGiB) albo zostaw rozpoznawanie automatyczne, - warstwy dostają polskie kolumny SYMBOL, PRZEZNACZENIE, GRUPA, RODZAJ_DOK, OZNACZENIE i WARSTWA_CAD.
DODATKOWO: upraszczanie współliniowych geometrii CAD, czyszczenie zdublowanych punktów, rozbijanie rysunku na osobne warstwy wg nazw warstw CAD, zachowanie kolorów z rysunku, wyodrębnianie podkładów rastrowych z KML, zapamiętywanie ustawień i folderów.
WYMAGANIA: QGIS 3.22 lub nowszy — i nic więcej. Rysunki DWG czytamy wbudowanym w QGIS sterownikiem CAD (starsze zapisy, do R2000); nowszy plik DWG wystarczy zapisać w CAD-zie jako DXF.
*** ENGLISH (SHORT) *** Polish-language QGIS plugin that converts AutoCAD DXF/DWG, Microstation DGN, GML, KML/KMZ, GeoJSON, CSV/TSV, SpatiaLite, GPX, ArcGIS File Geodatabase and MS Access datasets into GeoPackage layers, and exports QGIS layers back to DXF, GML 3.2, KML and KMZ. No external tools, accounts or API keys are required. Imported planning and survey layers are automatically styled according to Polish regulations: local plan (MPZP) land-use designations, the 13 planning zones of the municipal general plan with the exact RGB values of the 2023 regulation, utility networks (GESUT) in their statutory branch colours, and cadastral (EGiB) layers. Polish national coordinate systems (PUWG 2000 zones 5-8, PUWG 1992) are recognised from the coordinates themselves. Layers receive Polish attribute columns. Based on the zero2cadgis plugin (GPL-2.0-or-later) — see ATRYBUCJA.md.

pyqgis_plugin.name: 02Route 3D - Multi-Criteria 3D Mobility Studio
pyqgis_plugin.description: Profile-aware urban mobility and 3D shortest-path studio with 15 user profiles, modal access controls, network readiness audit, AHP cost surfaces, OD matrices, and WebGL route inspection.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
02Route 3D is a profile-aware urban mobility, shortest-path, and 3D route inspection studio for QGIS. It routes across real QGIS line networks or bounded OpenStreetMap downloads using terrain, optional environmental rasters, road hierarchy, surface quality, direction, and modal access attributes.

Key Capabilities:
- 15 Mobility Profiles: pedestrian, inclusive mobility, micromobility, vehicle, freight, and emergency profiles with distinct speed, slope, stair, surface, and hierarchy constraints.
- Consistent Routing Policy: primary A*, Pareto, isochrone, batch, OD, and evacuation workflows respect the same access and physical constraints.
- Network Readiness Audit: annotated red/green LineStringZ output identifies blocked segments, one-way links, weak components, surface quality, and connectivity.
- Route Diagnostics: bounded network snapping plus snap-distance, expanded-node, and blocked-edge reporting.
- Biomechanical Kinematics: Tobler walking speed and Minetti metabolic energy, with mode-specific travel-time models.
- 15 Processing Algorithms: routes, isochrones, Pareto alternatives, OD matrices, accessibility equity, network QA, exports, and analytical reports.
- Interoperability: LineStringZ, GPX 1.1, GeoJSON 3D, AutoCAD DXF, and self-contained offline 3D HTML.

Inspiration & Acknowledgment:
The inclusive mobility persona framework is inspired by Transform Transport / Systematica research (UX-Mobility: Multi-User Walkability Route Planner, https://transformtransport.org/research/inclusive-mobility/ux-mobility-multi-user-walkability-route-planner/).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Zones d'influence visuelle (ZIV)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Visual influence zones (viewsheds) computed from national LiDAR elevation data: downloads the tiles covering an area of interest, merges them, computes the viewshed and loads the result styled in the project. Two countries: France (IGN LiDAR HD) and the contiguous United States (USGS 3DEP terrain, LANDFIRE vegetation height, USA Structures buildings, TIGER/Line roads). The country is detected from the area of interest, or forced from the form.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Visual Influence Zones computes viewsheds - zones of visual influence, also called ZTV or ZVI in landscape impact assessment - for a project site, from high-resolution national LiDAR elevation data. Typical use: assessing how far, and from where, a planned installation (solar farm, wind turbines, buildings) would be visible in the surrounding landscape. Given an area of interest, the plugin lists and downloads the elevation tiles that intersect it, merges and resamples them, computes the viewshed over the resulting terrain, and masks out woodland and buildings. The resulting raster is loaded into the project with a ready-made "night" styling. It can optionally suggest photo viewpoints for photomontages, spread evenly across disjoint visible patches and across distance rings, and placed on roads or close to buildings rather than in the middle of a field. This version covers two countries. France draws on the IGN LiDAR HD data published by the French National Geographic Institute, exactly as the parent plugin does. The contiguous United States draws on the USGS 3DEP elevation service for the terrain, LANDFIRE LF2023 existing vegetation height and canopy height for the occluding surface, FEMA/ORNL USA Structures for buildings and Census TIGER/Line for roads. The country is chosen from a "Country" field on the form, whose default deduces it from the centroid of the area of interest; an explicit choice always wins over the detection. Where the United States has no 1-metre LiDAR project - which is a matter of survey coverage, not of terrain: parts of Olympic National Park have none while the Nevada desert does - the terrain is served at 1/3 arc-second, about 10 metres, and the working resolution is raised to match instead of being interpolated up from coarser data. The log says so, so that a viewshed computed on a smoothed terrain is never mistaken for a fine one. The American chain is exercised end to end by its own test bench across five contrasting areas, on both supported QGIS versions. The France chain is the one this plugin has always shipped, unchanged. The visibility algorithms ship with the plugin as an internal Processing provider, so no companion plugin has to be installed. The only Python dependencies are requests and numpy, both already bundled with QGIS. The two-country chain grew as a separate line from version 1.5.3 of this plugin, so that the France chain kept running untouched while the American side was built, and was folded back in at 1.6.0 under the original identities: people already using the plugin receive an update, and find their stored preferences where they left them. Every fix shipped in the single-country line up to 1.5.6 is carried here. All of its code - tile import (import_dalles/), visibility engine (moteur_visibilite/), Processing algorithms (algorithmes_ziv/) and orchestration - is original code; no third-party code is included. Released under the GNU General Public License v3 or later; see the LICENSE file shipped with the plugin. Elevation and landcover data for France (c) IGN, Licence Ouverte / Open Licence.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Compartment Compass
pyqgis_plugin.description: Filter, search, and edit vector layer attributes in a spreadsheet-style table that stays in sync with the map — find the feature first, then confirm it on the map, then act on it. Helps manage data where the map and its attributes are closely linked, such as forest planning maps (森林計画図).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Most attribute-editing plugins start from selecting a feature on the map, then editing its attributes. Compartment Compass works the other way around: the attribute table is the starting point. Filter across any column with a per-column, spreadsheet-style search row to find the exact compartment you need, watch it get highlighted and zoomed on the map as you move through the table, and edit GeoPackage values directly in the table. Built for Japan's national and private forest planning map data, but works with any vector layer already loaded in the project; it does not download or install data itself.

pyqgis_plugin.name: OCR2Geometry
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create numbered points, lines and polygons from screenshots or pasted coordinate text.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Recognizes coordinates, provides spreadsheet-style manual entry with two-way DMS/DD conversion, highlights OCR confidence, exports CSV and validates geometry. RapidOCR and ONNX Runtime are external dependencies installed on demand into the QGIS user profile. Internet access is required only for the initial dependency installation. Current automatic setup is tested on Windows 10/11.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Hybrid IDW-Kriging Interpolator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Hybrid spatial interpolation combining IDW and Ordinary Kriging with CV, anisotropy and zones
pyqgis_plugin.about: Performs hybrid interpolation by combining IDW and Ordinary Kriging. Supports leave-one-out cross-validation, anisotropy, zone-based hybrid, and optional variance output.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Layout Splines
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds editable spline polyline and spline polygon node items to QGIS Layout Designer.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds Spline Polyline and Spline Polygon items to the Layout Designer's Add Node Item group. Cubic Bezier anchors and their incoming and outgoing control handles can be edited using QGIS's native Edit Nodes tool. Items retain the native polyline and polygon symbol, layout, undo, template, and project serialization behavior.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QUCORE (Variable UAS Corridor Planning)
pyqgis_plugin.description: QUCORE (QGIS UAS Corridor Outlining & Routing Engine) is a SORA-compliant QGIS Plugin for variable UAS Corridor Planning. Includes Flight Geography (FG), Contingency Volume (CV), and Ground Risk Buffer (GRB) calculations based on official guidelines.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Interactive drone route and safety buffer planning tool in QGIS (GPLv2+ Open Source). Free for private & academic use. Commercial users are invited to support via a Commercial Supporter License (€99/user per Major Version). Software provided as planning support - use at your own risk. No warranty for the accuracy of calculated spatial data.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGC4QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS integration plugin for QGroundControl.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Integration of QGroundControl with QGIS for UAV/drone mission planning and management.

pyqgis_plugin.name: JPRaincloudradarDownloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin that retrieves Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) Nowcast rain cloud radar data for a specified date and time and saves it to GeoPackage.
pyqgis_plugin.about: 日本の気象庁ナウキャスト雨雲レーダーを指定日時から取得しGeoPackageに保存し、時系列コントローラーでアニメーション表示できます。ダウンロード画像を公開・利用する場合は必ず気象庁の利用規約（https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/info/coment.html）を参照し、出典等を明示してください。

pyqgis_plugin.name: RapidIBF-Next
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin turns raw hazard and exposure data into simple, decision-ready impact estimates. Instead of stopping at "where the hazard will occur", it helps answer "who and what is likely to be affected, and by how much", so that governments and sector agencies can act early and target resources where they matter most. Includes tools for data classification, zonal statistics, and report generation.
pyqgis_plugin.about: RapidIBF-Next is an impact-based forecasting (IBF) toolkit for national hydro-meteorological services, disaster management offices and sector agencies. It combines a hazard layer (for example a seasonal climate outlook, a rainfall or temperature anomaly, a flood or landslide susceptibility raster, or a tropical cyclone wind swath) with exposure data (population rasters, point facilities such as schools and health centres, or line networks such as roads) and aggregates the result to administrative boundaries. Workflows cover raster hazard with raster exposure, raster hazard with point exposure, and raster hazard with line exposure. Outputs include classified impact layers styled in QGIS, GeoPackage and CSV exports, and a comprehensive HTML and PDF report with maps, charts and summary text. The report is available in English, Russian, Hindi, Tamil, Sinhala and Dhivehi, with terminology drawn from official government and disaster-risk-reduction sources. The plugin uses only libraries bundled with QGIS (GDAL, NumPy and Jinja2). No additional Python packages need to be installed. Developed by the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP).

pyqgis_plugin.name: basinkit
pyqgis_plugin.description: Click a river anywhere on Earth and get an analysis-ready basin package: elevation, terrain surfaces, land cover, soil, rainfall, surface water, rivers, full Horton-Strahler morphometry, a grade for whether the elevation model can carry any of it, a quality indicator for every other layer, and an eight-page report.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Click a point on any river in the world and get the basin draining into it, then pull DEM, land cover, soil, rainfall, surface water, rivers and lakes for that basin -- clipped and masked to the polygon, not to its bounding box. No account is needed for any of it. Delineation is validated blind against 2,550 gauges in 99 countries on six continents, whose catchment areas are published by the agencies that operate them, and the plugin reports which accuracy regime an answer falls in rather than quoting a single figure: 0.3 percent median area error above 100,000 square kilometres, 1.7 percent from 2,000 to 10,000. Below about 2,000 square kilometres the DEM backend is the right instrument, and the plugin says so at the moment it matters and switches to it where the evidence supports the switch. Other plugins delineate from a clicked point, and Sen Hydro does it well through the same public mghydro service this plugin can use. Three things here are different. The data: elevation, land cover, soil, rainfall, surface water, rivers and lakes come back as layers clipped to the polygon, not as a report. The morphometry: the full Horton-Strahler-Schumm set from one algorithm, with Strahler streams counted as streams rather than as the reaches a river dataset splits them into. And the offline path: the default backend walks the HydroBASINS level-12 graph from a cached local copy, so after the first download it needs no network at all. Every algorithm is a Processing algorithm, so batch mode, the Model Builder and qgis_process all work. SETUP: needs QGIS 3.28 or newer, because the package needs Python 3.10 (geopandas 1.0 and rasterio both do) and older QGIS builds ship Python 3.7 or 3.8, where pip cannot install it at all. QGIS 3.34 LTR and 3.40 are both new enough. This plugin runs on the Python package "basinkit", which is installed once with pip into the Python that QGIS itself uses. The plugin detects whether it is present and prints the exact command for your installation, so setup is a single copy and paste. The surest route on every platform is from the QGIS Python Console, which installs into the interpreter QGIS imports from; note that "!pip install" works only in Jupyter, not in the QGIS console. See the plugin homepage for details.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Topology Error Creator & Fixer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Safely detect, create and repair vector topology errors including invalid geometries, duplicates, polygon overlaps/gaps, and line overshoot/undershoot.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Topology Error Creator & Fixer provides controlled topology-error creation for training/QA plus automatic preprocessing that detects common topology problems and selects suitable repairs. Version 2.2.3 hardens exception handling for QGIS Plugin Repository security scanning by removing silent try/except pass/continue patterns and replacing the Bandit-flagged standard pseudo-random generator, while retaining Safe Processing mode for dense village/cadastral polygon layers. Supports single files and folders with Shapefile, GeoPackage and GeoJSON. Uses qgis.PyQt for QGIS 3.22 through QGIS 4.x compatibility.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Akmaul Hoque; Debashis Chakraborty; Manish Kumar Naskar

pyqgis_plugin.name: AI Agent
pyqgis_plugin.description: AI agent inside QGIS: explores your project and processes data from a plain-language request.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The agent inspects the open project, styles layers, runs Processing, edits data and creates layouts from plain-language requests. Changes wait in a visible plan until you press Apply. Sending a request shares your prompt, recent chat, project notes, basic layer and field metadata and tool results with the configured endpoint. The first send to each remote endpoint asks for confirmation; agreeing is remembered for that endpoint. Sensitive GIS data and tool results—feature attribute values; exact map and layer extents; layer filters and sources; style categories; Processing and Python results; and rendered map or layout images—require a separate option that is off by default. Optional web tools require per-call confirmation: searches contact DuckDuckGo or Wikipedia, geocoding contacts the Photon demo or custom Nominatim service selected in Settings, and page reads contact the approved public HTTPS host. Geocoding is disabled until a service is selected, and the public OSMF Nominatim instance is not offered. Private hosts and credential-bearing URLs are rejected. Web results are untrusted, may be sent to the configured model and are not cached on disk. Conversation messages and project notes are stored as plain JSON in the QGIS profile. When enabled, applied runs write an unencrypted Markdown journal containing shortened request and agent text, tool names, errors and outcome in the profile's ai_agent_runs directory; owner-only permissions are applied where supported, the path is reported and the file remains until the user deletes it. API keys are stored encrypted in the QGIS authentication database and unlocked by the QGIS master password; only the identifier of the stored entry reaches the settings file. The plugin has no external Python dependencies. OpenAI-compatible providers including Google Gemini, Anthropic and local endpoints are supported. A local server can still store or forward data. The interface is available in English and Russian.

pyqgis_plugin.name: DOP Germany
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automatically loads WMS DOP Deutschland layers with individual federal state toggles and geometry-based current map view filtering.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The DOP Germany plugin provides streamlined access to official German digital orthophotos (Digitale Orthophotos - DOP20). The underlying raster data originates from the State Surveying and Geoinformation Authorities of the German Federal States (Vermessungsverwaltungen der Bundesländer), compiled and provided nationwide as an OGC-compliant WMS service by the Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG) via the Geodatenzentrum at https://sg.geodatenzentrum.de/wms_dop. Each image features a high-resolution 20 cm ground resolution (1 pixel = 20 cm x 20 cm).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Basin HydroRisk
pyqgis_plugin.description: Preliminary hydrological and basin analysis from rainfall data and digital terrain models, including design rainfall, Gumbel EV1, GEV, Normal and Lognormal frequency analysis, IDF/CPP calibration, D8 basin delineation, morphometry, time of concentration, SCS-CN and Rational Method runoff calculations, and a consolidated report.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Preliminary hydrological and basin analysis from rainfall data and digital terrain models, including design rainfall, frequency analysis, IDF/CPP calibration, D8 basin delineation, morphometry, time of concentration, SCS-CN and Rational Method runoff calculations, and a consolidated report.

pyqgis_plugin.name: BDOT10k Import (QGIS 4.x)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Import, merging and visualisation (by plugin BDOT10k_GML_SHP) of county-level BDOT10k databases (GML) with automatic detection of the old (2011) and new (2021) schemas, into GeoPackage, GML, ESRI Geodatabase, SQLite, or GeoParquet. Version for QGIS 4.x (PyQt6). Import, scalanie i wizualizacja (za pomocą wtyczki BDOT10k_GML_SHP) powiatowych baz BDOT10k (GML) z automatycznym rozpoznawaniem starego (2011) i nowego (2021) schematu, do GeoPackage / GML / ESRI geobaza / SQLite / GeoParquet. Wersja dla QGIS 4.x (PyQt6).
pyqgis_plugin.about: W katalogu wejsciowym mają być pliki *.zip, katalog w srodku musi miec strukturę PL.PZGiK.336.2201 (okresla powiat). Instrukcja pojawia sie w postaci dymkow po najechaniu na wiersz lub opis. Importuje, scala i wizualizuje (za pomocą wtyczki BDOT10k_GML_SHP) powiatowe bazy BDOT10k (GML) z wielu powiatow w jedna baze wynikowa. Automatycznie rozpoznaje stary (2011) i nowy (2021) schemat, eksportuje do GeoPackage, GML, ESRI geobazy (.gdb) i SQLite/SpatiaLite, w dowolnej kombinacji formatow. W starym schemacie dołacza tabele zewnetrzne do własciwych warstw. Wizualizuje dane przy uzyciu wtyczki BDOT10k_GML_SHP. Podstawowy import daje wynik w postaci bazy gdzie wystepują kolumny tylko z danymi. Import xsd daje wynik w postaci bazy w postaci bazy gdzie jest pelna struktura, wystepuja kolumny zgodne ze schematem, w tym puste. Opcja pozwala na eksport z tłumaczeniem kodu warstwy.

pyqgis_plugin.name: BDOO Import (QGIS 4.x)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Import, merging and visualisation (by plugin BDOO_GML) of provincial BDOO databases (GML, 1:250,000) from multiple provinces into a single output database (GeoPackage / GML / ESRI geodatabase / SQLite / GeoParquet). Version for QGIS 4.x (PyQt6). Import, scalanie i wizualizacja (za pomocą wtyczki BDOO_GML) wojewodzkich baz BDOO (GML, 1:250 000) z wielu wojewodztw do jednej bazy wynikowej (GeoPackage / GML / ESRI geobaza / SQLite / GeoParquet). Wersja dla QGIS 4.x (PyQt6).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Instrukcja: w katalogu wejsciowym mają być pliki *.zip, katalog w srodku musi miec strukturę PL.PZGiK.201.02 (okresla wojewodztwo). Instrukcja pojawia sie w postaci dymkow po najechaniu na wiersz lub opis. Importuje, scala i wizualizuje (za pomoca wtyczki BDOO_GML) wojewodzkie bazy BDOO (dane ogolnogeograficzne 1:250 000, GML) z wielu wojewodztw w jedna baze wynikowa. Automatycznie rozpoznaje stary (2011) i nowy (2021)schemat, eksportuje do GeoPackage, GML, ESRI geobazy (.gdb) i SQLite/SpatiaLite, w dowolnej kombinacji formatow. Wizualizuje dane przy uzyciu wtyczki BDOO_GML Podstawowy import daje wynik w postaci bazy gdzie wystepują kolumny tylko z danymi. Import xsd daje wynik w postaci bazy w postaci bazy gdzie jest pelna struktura wystepuja kolumny zgodne ze schematem, w tym puste. Opcja pozwala na eksport z tłumaczeniem kodu warstwy. W starym schemacie dołacza tabele zewnetrzne do własciwych warstw. Ta wersja jest przeznaczona wylacznie dla QGIS 4.x (PyQt6, bezposrednie importy bez warstwy posredniej qgis.PyQt) - dla QGIS 3.x zainstaluj osobna wtyczke "Import BDOO (QGIS 3.x)".

pyqgis_plugin.name: Raster Transform
pyqgis_plugin.description: Move, rotate and scale raster layers without resampling the original pixels. The transformation is stored in the GeoTIFF affine georeferencing.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Raster Transform ermöglicht das Verschieben, Drehen und Skalieren eines Rasterlayers ohne Resampling der Originalpixel. Beim Speichern wird ein neuer GeoTIFF erzeugt; Pixelanzahl, Bandstruktur, Datentyp und Rasterauflösung bleiben erhalten. Die Transformation wird über die affine GeoTIFF-Georeferenzierung gespeichert.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Tessela Estilos Prontos
pyqgis_plugin.description: Browse and download ready-made QGIS style themes with a real preview, straight from the toolbar.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Tessela lets you browse style "themes" (sets of layers with matching colors, symbols and labels) published by the plugin's maintainer, with a real preview rendered by QGIS. Free themes download instantly; paid themes open the seller's checkout page in your browser. Reads a public GitHub repository only — no account needed to use it.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Remove Temporary Layers
pyqgis_plugin.description: Review and safely remove temporary layers (vector, raster, mesh, point cloud) from your QGIS project.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds a convenient button to the Layers panel toolbar and Plugins menu to find, review, and safely remove temporary project layers via an interactive selection dialog.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoSIG Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Professional GIS geoprocessing suite built on QGIS Processing's native algorithms ("Native First"). 48 tools across 8 groups: Overlay (9), Proximity (6), Extraction (7), Sampling (5), Attribute table (8), Digitizing (6), Spatial Analysis (4) and Cartography (3). Note: the plugin's menu, tool names and parameter labels are in Spanish.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoSIG Tools organizes, simplifies, and expands access to professional GIS tools, always prioritizing the native QGIS Processing engine (native:*) over custom code or external dependencies. It features a modular architecture designed to grow with new groups (Geometry, Vector, Raster, Selection, Spatial Statistics, GIS Utilities) without modifying existing ones. The only documented exception to "Native First" is "Dynamic Table" (Attribute Table group), built with custom Python code because QGIS Processing does not offer an equivalent native algorithm.
