pyqgis_plugin.name: CRAG
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS plugin for Collection and Reporting of Associated Geodata (CRAG). The plugin adds layers and tools for geological map data collection in QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS plugin for Collection and Reporting of Associated Geodata (CRAG). The plugin adds layers and tools for geological map data collection in QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: SecureGeoPackage
pyqgis_plugin.description: Encrypt tables and columns inside a GeoPackage, grant access by public key with roles, and open what you are allowed to read. The file stays a valid GeoPackage.
pyqgis_plugin.about: SecureGeoPackage implements the egpkg_encryption GeoPackage extension. Seal whole layers or single columns of any GeoPackage; the unsealed layers stay readable for everyone in any GIS. Access is granted to public identities (keys, never passwords) with roles: reader, contributor, writer, admin. A signed public header shows who may do what under pseudonyms; names live encrypted. Rows of encrypted-column tables carry the author's and the validator's signature, so a contributor's rows stay pending until a writer validates them. Identities live in the QGIS Authentication Manager or the platform key store and move between machines with a one-time code. Dependencies: none beyond QGIS; all cryptography is pure Python and bundled. Optional: the "cryptography" package as an accelerator when present; on macOS the system "security" tool and on Linux "secret-tool" (libsecret) for the OS key store, otherwise the QGIS Authentication Manager is used. A private production by Captain Ahab & Cosmo, GPL-3.0-or-later (full attribution in the bundled LICENSE).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Item Highlighter
pyqgis_plugin.description: Locate and highlight map features from attribute values with automatic zoom support.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Item Highlighter helps users quickly locate and highlight features across multiple layers using attribute values. Instead of manually searching through attribute tables and navigating between layers, users can select predefined values from simple dropdown lists. Matching features are automatically highlighted and the map view zooms to their location. Custom highlight colors and styles can be configured for each layer.

pyqgis_plugin.name: J3M IoT Connector
pyqgis_plugin.description: Connect QGIS to J3M IoT data, collection sessions, and environmental indicators for geoprocessing and microclimate analysis.
pyqgis_plugin.about: J3M IoT Connector integrates QGIS with the J3M platform, providing direct access to georeferenced IoT data, collection sessions, and indicators focused on geoprocessing and microclimate analysis.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GISPublisher
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate and deploy interactive GIS web applications directly from QGIS layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
GISPublisher Plugin integrates the GISPublisher tool into QGIS, allowing you to generate and deploy interactive GIS web applications directly from the layers loaded in your QGIS project. Select vector or raster layers, build or attach Vega/Vega-Lite charts, and include QGIS geoprocessing models discovered automatically from your project and profile, then generate a complete web app or deploy it to local, SSH, or AWS environments - all without leaving QGIS. Layer/chart/model selections and deploy history are remembered between sessions.
External dependencies (must be installed before use): - Node.js 19 or later (https://nodejs.org/en/download) - GISPublisher npm package: npm install -g @lbdudc/gis-publisher

pyqgis_plugin.name: ClaudIA QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Sua IA (Claude, ChatGPT…) operando o QGIS pela comunidade agrônomo10X — Let your AI assistant operate QGIS through the agrônomo10X community
pyqgis_plugin.about:
ClaudIA QGIS conecta o QGIS aberto no seu computador à comunidade agrônomo10X (OagronomIA). A sua IA — Claude, ChatGPT ou qualquer cliente MCP — recebe mais de 100 ferramentas para enxergar e operar o seu projeto: listar e adicionar camadas, ler atributos, rodar algoritmos do Processing, aplicar estilos, renderizar o mapa, montar layouts de impressão e muito mais. Sem instalar Python, sem abrir portas: o plugin busca os comandos na comunidade por HTTPS e devolve os resultados.
É preciso ter conta na comunidade agrônomo10X com a solução ClaudIA QGIS liberada: https://comunidade.agronomos.ia.br/solucoes/mcp/claudia-qgis
O que o plugin envia à comunidade: a versão do QGIS, o nome do projeto aberto e o resultado dos comandos que a SUA IA pedir. Nada sai sem um comando seu; o token pode ser revogado na sua página a qualquer momento.
---
ClaudIA QGIS connects the QGIS running on your computer to the agrônomo10X community (OagronomIA). Your AI assistant — Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client — gets 100+ tools to inspect and operate your project: layers, attributes, Processing algorithms, styling, map rendering, print layouts and more. No Python setup, no open ports: the plugin long-polls the community over HTTPS and posts the results back. Requires an agrônomo10X community account with ClaudIA QGIS enabled.
Free software (GPLv2+). Derived from "QGIS MCP" by Nicolas Karasiak (https://github.com/nkarasiak/qgis-mcp, GPLv2+): the command handlers that run inside QGIS are his work; ClaudIA QGIS replaces the local socket server with the community connection.

pyqgis_plugin.name: STAplus SCK
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS 4 plugin for STAplus SCK: AUTHENIX login via QGIS OAuth2, kit serial, and MQTT publish.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS 4 plugin that adapts AUTHENIX and STAplus pieces from the STAplus-SCK-App. It signs in with a public AUTHENIX client using QGIS OAuth2 (authorization code + PKCE, system browser, loopback redirect), extracts the access token for STAplus HTTP and MQTT, reads a Smart Citizen Kit over serial, and publishes ObservationGroups. Plugin messages appear under the "STAplus SCK" tab in the QGIS Log Messages panel.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Inpaint AI Cloud
pyqgis_plugin.description: Bilingual cloud AI inpainting for orthophotos in QGIS using OpenAI Image Edit
pyqgis_plugin.about: Bilingual PL/EN cloud inpainting workflow specialized for realistic orthophoto editing. Requires an OpenAI API account, API key, internet access and QGIS Authentication Manager. Image crops, masks and prompts are sent to the external OpenAI Image Edit service only after user consent.

pyqgis_plugin.name: SeaState US
pyqgis_plugin.description: Load U.S. NOAA coastal observations — tide-gauge water levels, tide predictions, and offshore buoys — as time-aware QGIS layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: SeaState US pulls data from NOAA CO-OPS (Tides & Currents tide-gauge stations) and the National Data Buoy Center (NDBC offshore buoys) into QGIS as styled point layers, and charts any layer as a time series. Coverage is U.S. coasts, the Great Lakes, and territories. Uses keyless public APIs — no account required.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Analisi territoriale
pyqgis_plugin.description: Territorial intelligence and cartographic production suite: define an area, analyse constraints, query the Italian cadastre, download data, build maps and reports.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Analisi territoriale turns a geographic area into knowledge: it queries a configurable catalogue of official OGC services (WMS/WFS/WMTS/XYZ/OGC API), the INSPIRE cadastral service of Agenzia delle Entrate, terrain data and OpenStreetMap, measures intersections and distances, and produces organised layers, professional print layouts and a territorial dossier with full data provenance. The plugin reports cartographic evidence and always distinguishes it from legally ascertained constraints; it never issues an automatic legal assessment.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Wherobots
pyqgis_plugin.description: Connect to Wherobots Cloud for spatial SQL queries, data upload, and raster operations.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Integrates Wherobots Cloud spatial computing platform with QGIS. Execute spatial SQL queries and view results as map layers, upload local layers to Wherobots tables, and query raster data directly into your map canvas. Compatible with QGIS 3.x (Qt5) and QGIS 4.0 (Qt6).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Quick Features
pyqgis_plugin.description: Use feature templates and keyboard shortcuts to accelerate the manual creation of features
pyqgis_plugin.about: Use feature templates and keyboard shortcuts to accelerate the manual creation of features

pyqgis_plugin.name: Srot
pyqgis_plugin.description: Verified Indian government geodata inside QGIS: 342 ISRO Bhuvan layers across 44 states, Census and Survey of India boundaries, and live data.gov.in feeds. Browse and add without any model; each layer is probed before loading and carries its own citation.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Srot turns plain-language requests into real QGIS work, with Indian geodata built in. Ask for "the boundary of Pune district and every hospital in it" or "load LULC for Andhra Pradesh and clip it to Guntur", and the agent resolves the place, fetches the data from verified Indian sources, and runs the geoprocessing. . What makes it different from other AI plugins: * India-first data catalogue - 342 ISRO Bhuvan WMS layers covering 44 states and union territories (land use, village boundaries, slope, road and rail networks, hydrology, groundwater levels and all 23 river basins), Bhuvan satellite imagery, data.gov.in (live CPCB air quality, IMD gridded rainfall, hospital directory, crop production, mandi prices), Census 2011 boundaries, and OpenStreetMap. * A gazetteer that handles Indian naming in practice - Bengaluru/Bangalore, Prayagraj/Allahabad, Varanasi/Banaras all resolve offline, and boundary files of different vintages are detected rather than assumed, so asking for Telangana works on both the current and the pre-2014 district sets. * Safety by construction - the agent never runs generated Python. Every action is a declared tool, and Processing calls are validated against the algorithm registry before they execute. * Zero third-party Python dependencies. Nothing to pip install. Uses only PyQGIS and Qt, so it installs cleanly on Windows, macOS and Linux and honours your QGIS proxy settings. * Works fully offline with a local Ollama model, or with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. API keys are stored encrypted in the QGIS Authentication Manager. * Works with no model at all - the Browse tab lists the whole catalogue and adds any layer with one click, needing no model and no provider. Only the data.gov.in feeds ask for a free portal key. The natural-language tab is an optional layer on top. * Reproducible - every session is recorded as a runnable PyQGIS script you can save, review and re-run. * Citation-ready - each layer carries its publisher, licence, citation and retrieval date in the layer's own metadata, and the whole project exports as a source list in plain text, Markdown or BibTeX.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TopoFast
pyqgis_plugin.description: Draw an area on the map and automatically get the DEM (OpenTopography) and its contour lines with a single click.
pyqgis_plugin.about: TopoFast automates the workflow: select an area -> download the matching DEM from the OpenTopography API -> extract contour lines with GDAL, loading both layers into the project. Requires a free OpenTopography API Key (https://opentopography.org/). Español: TopoFast automatiza el flujo: seleccionar un área -> descargar el DEM correspondiente desde la API de OpenTopography -> extraer las curvas de nivel con GDAL, cargando ambas capas en el proyecto. Requiere una API Key gratuita de https://opentopography.org/.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Coastal Inundation Under Climate Change
pyqgis_plugin.description: Sea level rise flood mapping with hydraulic connectivity and DEM uncertainty bands
pyqgis_plugin.about: Plugin created by Daniel Ibarra Marinas, Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias, Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas. Floods only what lies below the new sea level and connects to the sea. Uncertainty bands from DEM RMSE and projection sigma, classified disconnected low areas, styled GeoTIFF and GeoPackage outputs, statistics and metadata. Static model: no erosion, waves or drainage. Interface in English and Spanish.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Daniel Ibarra Marinas, Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias, Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas

pyqgis_plugin.name: Stormwater Drainage Plot and Design
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plot TUFLOW pipe and pit layers as a long section, and design new stormwater pipe runs on it.

pyqgis_plugin.name: DEM-o-gorgon
pyqgis_plugin.description: Flip your DEM into the upside down: invert elevations and apply a dark retro-horror style. / Dale la vuelta a tu DEM: invierte las alturas y aplica un estilo oscuro de terror retro.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
DEM-o-gorgon inverts a digital elevation model (peaks become pits, valleys become ridges) and applies a ready-made dark style with red hillshade and glow. Fun for outreach, useful for analysis: inverted DEMs help extract ridgelines and divides with standard hydrology tools. Created by Daniel Ibarra-Marinas (Laboratorio Ocean from Space, UAT) and Alejandro Fenollar-Rueda (Universidad de Alicante).
DEM-o-gorgon invierte un modelo digital de elevaciones (los picos se vuelven fosas y los valles, crestas) y le aplica un estilo oscuro con sombreado rojo y brillo. Divertido para divulgar y útil para analizar: los DEM invertidos sirven para sacar crestas y divisorias con las herramientas de hidrología de siempre. Creado por Daniel Ibarra-Marinas (Laboratorio Ocean from Space, UAT) y Alejandro Fenollar-Rueda (Universidad de Alicante).

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS-LISFLOOD-FP
pyqgis_plugin.description: Build, run and map LISFLOOD-FP hydraulic flood inundation models
pyqgis_plugin.about: Drives the LISFLOOD-FP 2D hydraulic flood model from QGIS. Builds the model deck from your layers (DEM, Manning's n, boundary points, rainfall, time series), runs the model with live progress and cancellation, and loads the results as styled, georeferenced layers wired to the temporal controller. The plugin does not distribute LISFLOOD-FP itself; it compiles or locates a copy from your own source checkout.

pyqgis_plugin.name: CRS Overview
pyqgis_plugin.description: Lists all layers in the project grouped by CRS and highlights layers with a custom or invalid CRS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Dock widget that gives a quick overview of which coordinate reference systems are in use across the current project. Layers are grouped by CRS; groups with a custom (user-defined) or invalid/unset CRS are highlighted so mismatches are easy to spot before they cause problems downstream.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GIS in Style
pyqgis_plugin.description: Personal liveries for the QGIS interface: colours, fonts, your name and your symbol, a custom cursor and, if you like, kittens, puppies and turtles.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Pick a livery from the gallery, type your name and choose a symbol for the top-right corner. It includes a custom cursor, a short intro at startup, a race number in the status bar and, optionally, kittens (from Miau-o-rama), puppies and turtles that follow the cursor. When the plugin is disabled, QGIS goes back to exactly how it was. It never touches layers, their styles or projects, and it makes no network connections. Fonts: Barlow and Barlow Condensed (SIL Open Font License), bundled with the plugin.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Geodit
pyqgis_plugin.description: Edit your Geodit survey area in QGIS and keep it in sync with the server (project owners, admins and editors).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Requires a Geodit account (https://geodit.in), for project owners, admins and editors. Sign in to Geodit, open a map-based project and work on the features inside the survey area assigned to you. Edits you save in QGIS are uploaded automatically, following the project's Page access, and changes made on the web or in the Android app are downloaded at a configurable interval. Works offline: unsynced edits stay on this computer until the next sync.
